snl.41-19: Brie Larson will make her debut as host of "Saturday Night Live" on May 7. The Academy Award-winning actress ("Room") can be seen in the upcoming films "Kong: Skull Island" and "The Glass Castle." Joining Larson will be returning musical guest Alicia Keys. A 15-time Grammy Award-winning singer/songwriter/producer, Keys will debut her new single, "In Common," from her forthcoming album on "SNL." She'll also be joining season 11 of "The Voice" as a coach this fall.
snl.41-20: Drake returns to Studio 8H on May 14, his second time doubling as host and musical guest. The Grammy Award winner's fourth studio album, "Views," was released April 29.
snl.41-21: On May 21, former "SNL" cast member Fred Armisen returns to Studio 8H as host to close out the late-night franchise's 41st season. Armisen stars in IFC's Emmy-nominated "Portlandia" and "Documentary Now" series. Armisen was a cast member on "SNL" for 11 seasons. Courtney Barnett will make her debut as musical guest alongside Armisen. Barnett's first album, "Sometimes I Sit and Think, and Sometimes I Just Sit," received widespread acclaim and earned her a Grammy nomination for Best New Artist.

snl.43-1: Returning for the second time as host, the twice Oscar-nominated Gosling is set to star in the sci-fi drama "Blade Runner 2049," which opens Oct. 6.Accompanying Gosling on the season premiere will be Grammy Award-winning icon Jay-Z, who will be making his fourth appearance as musical guest. Jay-Z's album "4:44" was released in June, and he will embark on a world tour beginning Oct. 27.
snl.43-2: Gadot, who will be making her first "SNL" appearance, starred in summer's #1 film, "Wonder Woman," which earned more than $400 million at the domestic box office. Gadot will next co-star in the highly anticipated "Justice League," arriving in theaters Nov. 17.Joining Gadot will be Grammy-, Oscar- and Golden Globe-winning artist Sam Smith, marking his second visit to "SNL" as musical guest. Smith dropped a new single, "Too Good at Goodbyes," on Sept. 8 in preparation for his upcoming second studio album release.
snl.43-3: Kumail Nanjiani will host the season's third show on Oct. 14, marking his debut. Nanjiani stars as Dinesh Chugtai in HBO's "Silicon Valley" and most recently wrote and starred in the critically-acclaimed film "The Big Sick."Grammy Award-winning artist P!nk will join Nanjiani for the season's third episode as musical guest. Her seventh studio album, "Beautiful Trauma," is due out Oct. 13. P!nk was recently honored at the MTV VMAs with the Michael Jackson Video Vanguard Award in August.

U2's North American tour, "eXPERIENCE + iNNOCENCE" kicks off in May.
snl.43-8: James Franco will return for a fourth time as host. snl.43-10: Golden Globe winner Sam Rockwell will make his hosting debut when "Saturday Night Live" returns for the new year. canadas-drag-race.6-1: To kick off the season, the queens will star in their own music video featuring a very special guest, in hopes of impressing the judges. Guest judge is Paula Abdul.
canadas-drag-race.6-2: The queens team up to write and film cruise ship commercials. Guest judge is Glamzilla.
canadas-drag-race.6-3: The queens will choose their own adventure picking between two of the most feared Drag Race maxi challenges. Guest judge is Icesis Couture.
canadas-drag-race.6-4: Reading Battles pit the queens against each other in a roast off. Guest judge is Alyssa Edwards.
canadas-drag-race.6-5: The queens team up to host segments on the new drag talk show, The Shade. Guest judge is Kiesza.
canadas-drag-race.6-6: The lip-syncing tournament Slayoffs are back and the queens battle for the title of being this season's lip sync assassin.
canadas-drag-race.6-7: The queens are tasked with designing a look for Brooke Lynn Hytes. Guest judge is ERDEM.
canadas-drag-race.6-8: The queens have to earn their spot in the finale as they navigate a series of challenges. Guest judge is Allison Russell.
canadas-drag-race.6-9: The queens write, record, and perform their debut singles in hopes of being crowned Canada's Next Drag Superstar. Guest judge is Rufus Wainwright.
canadas-drag-race.0-8: Beach, please! Canada's Drag Race is BACK with 12 queens facing off for the title of "Canada's Next Drag Superstar."

drag-race-down-under.1-1: We meet the Australian and New Zealand Drag Queens who will be competing to become Down Under's first Drag Race Superstar. It's a hometown homage this week, as the Queens showcase their personalities in the ‘Get to Know You' Ball.
drag-race-down-under.1-2: It's the time we've all been waiting for, as the queens don their best celebrity get-ups to compete in the infamous celebrity impression Olympics. It's Snatch Game, baby!
drag-race-down-under.1-3: The queens are split in two as they compete in the ultimate girl group sing-off.
drag-race-down-under.1-4: The queens are put through their paces with a sewing challenge that has them showcasing their best thrift flip.
drag-race-down-under.1-5: The queens put their marketing hats on, as they are given the challenge to create and market a product, green screen infomercial and all.
drag-race-down-under.1-6: Can you see the family resemblance? The queens are challenged to makeover and raise their very own drag family members, out of drag first-timers.
drag-race-down-under.1-7: The queens compete in a talent show and attempt to cement their place in the finale of RuPaul's Drag Race Down Under.
drag-race-down-under.1-8: The final queens write their own verses to RuPaul's "I'm a Winner, Baby" and compete to be crowned winner of the first season of RuPaul's Drag Race Down Under.
drag-race-down-under.2-1: Mama Ru returns for more shenanigans as ten new queens from all across Australia and New Zealand compete for the title of Down Under's Next Drag Superstar, and this time there's a $50k cash prize at stake!The queens are thrown in at the deep end as they are tasked with creating fashion forward garments out of recyclable and natural materials.
drag-race-down-under.2-2: The queens are split into two groups, before their acting chops are put to the test in original screenplay Caged Queens, a prison-based dramedy.
drag-race-down-under.2-3: The queens pair up as they harness their hosting skills in a Drag Brunch style challenge.
drag-race-down-under.2-4: The queens have to impersonate celebrities in the legendary Snatch Game.
drag-race-down-under.2-5: The queens have to choose their own teams as they write and record verses that throw shade to their own band members in this week's girl group challenge.
drag-race-down-under.2-6: The queens have to sell themselves while creating an advertisement that showcases the main tourist attractions of their hometowns.
drag-race-down-under.2-7: The queens are challenged to transform a family of men into gorgeous glamazons.
drag-race-down-under.2-8: The final three queens write and record their own verses to RuPaul's "Who is She" as they prepare to perform on the mainstage for the last time, competing for the title of the Next Drag Superstar!
drag-race-down-under.3-1: Mama Ru returns as ten new queens from all across Australia & New Zealand compete for the title of Down Under's Next Drag Superstar! For their first challenge, the queens throw a Mardi Gras Pride-themed celebration on the main stage.
drag-race-down-under.3-2: The queens are invited to Muriel's Wedding – but without a thing to wear, they must design their wedding couture from leftover bedding materials.
drag-race-down-under.3-3: The queens split into teams as they improv their way through a reunion special of The Fake Housewives of Down Under.
drag-race-down-under.3-4: The queens have to impersonate celebrities in the legendary Snatch Game.
drag-race-down-under.3-5: Inspired by the campy ‘80s film "BMX Bandits" the queens write original lyrics, sing and dance as two rival girl groups.
drag-race-down-under.3-6: The queens are showcasing their charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talents at the annual Drag Brunch.
drag-race-down-under.3-7: The queens makeover dog lovers and their fur babies into drag divas.
drag-race-down-under.3-8: As their final challenge, the top three queens collaborate on a new remix of RuPaul's "Crying on the Dancefloor." And RuPaul crowns Down Under's Next Drag Superstar.
drag-race-down-under.0-1: Meet the queens from RuPaul's Drag Race Down Under!
drag-race-down-under.0-2: Meet the new queens who want to prove they've got what it takes to be the next Down Under Superstar!
drag-race-down-under.0-3: Ahoy! It's time to meet Ru's new crew of swashbuckling queens.
drag-race-down-under.0-4: Hey Dolls, are you ready to meet your season 4 queens?
drag-race-down-under.4-1: New host Michelle Visage presides as head judge as a fresh set of queens from across Australia and New Zealand enter the werkroom to prove they are the best of the best.In this opening episode, the queens meet each other for the first time, and for their first icebreaker challenge they must double up AND double down...
drag-race-down-under.4-2: In Olivia Newton-John inspired rival Girl Groups, the queens must record their own verses and learn choreography to entertain on the main stage.
drag-race-down-under.4-3: The queens must impersonate celebrities in the legendary Snatch Game with an adventurous outback twist.
drag-race-down-under.4-4: The queens need to design and sew their own fierce fabulous fashion but first they must unpack the materials with the help of the Pit Crew.
drag-race-down-under.4-5: It's reading time, and the queens must transform librarians into drag divas in a makeover challenge.
drag-race-down-under.4-6: The queens compete for the starring role in a new soap in a dramatic acting challenge.
drag-race-down-under.4-7: The comedy chops of the remaining queens are tested as they are challenged to royally roast their resident judge Rhys Nicholson.
drag-race-down-under.4-8: The final queens compete for the $50,000 by writing their own verses and learning their most challenging choreography yet for their last Main Stage performance. We're ready to crown a winner, baby!

drag-race-espana.1-1: The queens land on the set and face their first challenge: riding a mechanical bull while posing for a photographer. Next, their skills are put to the test as they will have to design and produce runway-friendly looks from flea market items. The international actor and model Jon Kortajarena joins the jury as a guest, made up of Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi, creators of 'Veneno', and the designer and National Fashion Design Award 2020 Ana Locking. His verdict will mean the first farewell to the contest of one of the contestants.
drag-race-espana.1-2: After a fun word game with the handsome Spanish Pit Crew, the pressure mounts as the queens work together in teams and their singing and dancing skills are put to the test in the maxi challenge. Then the runway gets emotional as the queens pay tribute to Spanish superstar La Veneno in front of her lifelong friend. Veneno star Paca la Piraña joins the creators of award-winning TV sensation Veneno - Javier Calvo, Javier Ambrossi and award-winning designer Ana Locking on the judging panel as another queen exits the competition.
drag-race-espana.1-3: The search for Spain's First Drag Race Superstar continues. This week Supremme Deluxe tests the queens' ball skills in a typically Spanish football challenge, then tasks them with creating their own advertising brand based on the Spanish concept Mocatriz – modelo/cantante/actriz (model/singer/actress). Almodovar actor and star of Spanish supergroup Ojete Calor (Asshole Heat) Carlos Areces joins the judging panel as a third queen leaves the competition.
drag-race-espana.1-4: This week the queens' growing friendships are tested as they read each other for the first time. Then it's the moment we've all been waiting for as Spain hosts its inaugural Snatch Game. And in a jam-packed episode the queens present no less than three runway looks in homage to the many looks of the women of Spain. Trap superstar Bad Gyal joins the judging panel as a fourth queen exits the competition.
drag-race-espana.1-5: Working in pairs the queens get into the time-honored Spanish tradition of treading grapes in a barrel before they are tasked with treading the boards in their first-ever acting challenge based on one of Spain ́s most popular dramas. This week's runway is an homage to the world-renowned Spanish stars of the art world. Legendary Spanish Queen of Pop Alaska joins the judging panel as a fifth queen sashays away from the competition.
drag-race-espana.1-6: This week the queens showcase their stand-up comedy skills as they are charged with roasting the judges. Helping them mould their routines is the star of TV sensation "Paquita Salas" Brays Efe. The runway is a tribute to Spain ́s biggest music superstar Rosalia. Comedian Susi Caramello joins the judging panel as another queen sashays away.
drag-race-espana.1-7: With only four remaining, this week the queens once again put their dress-making and design skills to the test as they are paired with members of Spain's first inclusive rugby club Madrid Titanes in an emotional drag makeover challenge. Winner of Drag Race Holland Envy Peru joins the judging panel as all roads lead to the dramatic final.
drag-race-espana.1-8: All the queens are welcomed back for the first Drag Race España reunion show! They will review everything that has happened over the season, crown España's first Miss Congeniality, and look ahead to next week's grand finale!
drag-race-espana.1-9: Supremme de Luxe's search for the first superstar of Drag Race España comes to a spectacular end. In their last challenge, the final three queens will record a video and perform an elaborate song and dance choreography to impress the judges and claim the crown. Javier Ambrossi, Javier Calvo and Ana Locking, as well as the eliminated queens, return to accompany the three finalists in one last lipsync before Supremme de Luxe crowns the winner of the first edition of 'Drag Race España'.
drag-race-espana.1-10: Carmen Farala, Killer Queen and Sagittaria will discover at the same time as viewers who the winner of the first edition of the program is in a special installment hosted by presenter Jonathan Ruiz. During 'The Coronation', the finalists will view the final program for the first time and we will see the reaction of the winner live. In addition, during this special broadcast, the three queens will review their trajectory in the program and will remember the best moments of the first and successful edition of 'Drag Race España'.
drag-race-espana.2-1: Season 2 kicks off with 12 new queens, an artistic first mini challenge, and a double runway.
drag-race-espana.2-2: The library is officially open before the first talent show at Drag Race España. The remaining eleven queens will have to win over the jury in a maxi challenge in which they will show what they do best. All this, before parading on a catwalk that promises to be terrifying with La Zowi as guest judge.
drag-race-espana.2-3: This week, the ten remaining queens in the competition will get stuck in the mini-challenge of 'El juego de la loca' if they are not very knowledgable in culture and popular wisdom. In addition, they will have to put their improvisation skills to the test in 'El Diario de Putricia' and pay tribute on the catwalk to one of our most acclaimed directors. The category is: Almodóvar Women. All under the watchful eye of our guest judge, Eduardo Casanova.
drag-race-espana.2-4: The first musical by Javier Ambrossi and Javier Calvo arrives at Drag Race España. Our jury has adapted their hit musical 'La Llamada' to give it a heavenly drag twist. In addition, La Prohibida sits at the jury's table to assess the work of the nine queens remaining in the competition.
drag-race-espana.2-5: Wigs will literally fly in our mini poetry reading challenge. In addition, the eight queens that are still in the competition face the most anticipated game, the Snatch Game. Who will be the Celebrities that we will see in the panel? Will they manage to convince the guest judge actress María León?
drag-race-espana.2-6: Choriza May visits us this week to witness the Ball with a triple catwalk through Spain in 3 centuries. In the maxi challenge, the seven queens who are still in the competition will have to make one of the looks with recyclable materials and show that fashion can and should be sustainable.
drag-race-espana.2-7: The race for the crown becomes fiercer in Drag Race España with a mini challenge that will test the strength of our fighters. And for the maxi challenge, the queens will have to present the best of our country, starring in three advertising spots in which they must convince the world that Spain is their best holiday destination. In addition, this week the singer Ruth Lorenzo visits us.
drag-race-espana.2-8: This week's mini-challenge is starring the Draguiñoles because everyone likes... puppets! And in the maxi challenge, the five queens who are still up for the crown will have to roast some very special guests: Dovima Nurmi, Pupi Poisson, Killer Queen, Sagittaria and Carmen Farala, who will be read before the attentive gaze of actress Anabel Alonso, our guest judge.
drag-race-espana.2-9: In the last mini-challenge of the season, our queens will have to guess what some mystery boxes are hiding before preparing for the Makeover. On this occasion, and under the watchful eye of Alexis Mateo, they will have to drag the members of the December 26 Foundation, the gay retirees who have founded the first LGBTQ nursing home in Spain.
drag-race-espana.2-10: The 12 queens of the second season of 'Drag Race España' come face to face to settle some pending accounts and talk about their time on the show. A VIP reunion with very special messages, the election of Miss Congeniality and an unexpected catwalk are among many other surprises.
drag-race-espana.2-11: The final is here and only four queens are eligible for the crown: Estrella Xtravaganza, Marina, Sharonne or Venedita Von Däsh. One of them will be crowned the second Spanish Drag superstar after having to write their own verse and defend a choreography for a song that can take them to heaven. A final in style with all the contestants of the second season.
drag-race-espana.2-12: Sharonne has been crowned the second Spanish drag superstar in front of over 15,000 people. A special episode in which the twelve contestants of the second season have been received by the public and have reacted to the grand finale accompanying Estrella Xtravaganza, Marina, Sharonne and Venedita Von Däsh in their final stretch for the crown.
drag-race-espana.3-1: The third season of Drag Race Spain starts with the new queens playing farm animals in the traditional photo shoot. After wallowing in the mud, the racers will have to demonstrate their greatest talent in the great Supremme Eleganza Talent Extravaganza under the watchful eye of Supreme, Javier Ambrossi, Ana Locking, Javier Calvo and the guest judge Paco Léon.
drag-race-espana.3-2: How much do you love Eurovision? The queens will have to test their knowledge of the contest by submitting to a geographical challenge and a maxi team choreography of Chanel's iconic "Slo - Mo". For the catwalk, the racers will have to reinterpret the most iconic looks of Spanish representatives in Eurovision. All this under the watchful eye of the judges, Supreme and guest judge Soraya.
drag-race-espana.3-3: This week the queens will have to make their drag reinterpretation of Spanish regional costumes and transform them into catwalk looks. To assess their creations, Palomo Spain will be part of the panel.
drag-race-espana.3-4: The queens will have to face the most terrifyingly fun challenge: making their own drag sequel to the most popular Spanish horror movies. But first we will see how to blow up balloons with the help of the Pit Crew to form the teams. To become true scream queens, they will have the direction of Paco Plaza. The catwalk will also be scary. The category is: My worst self.
drag-race-espana.3-5: The library is officially open before the queens take on the most iconic challenge of the season: The snatch game. Who will be the Celebrities that we will see in the panel? Will they be able to convince La Terremoto de Alcorcón when she visits us as a guest judge?
drag-race-espana.3-6: The musical returns to Drag Race España. After having to undergo a surprise casting, the queens will have to assume their roles in 'El Mago Precoz', the adaptation of the classic story of The Wizard of Oz set in La Movida Madrileña. Mónica Cruz joins the jury to assess them as interpreters, singers and dancers. Who will be the most complete queen? In the final catwalk the category is: Three looks in one.
drag-race-espana.3-7: The time has come to give the eliminated queens a second chance. To do this they will have to create and interpret a comedy routine forming a pair with the queens that are still in the contest. To judge their interpretation today, the comedian Eva Soriano joins the jury. Finally, the queens will have to take out their best wigs to give it their all in the wigapalooza.
drag-race-espana.3-8: Blind makeup for couples! After the mini challenge, the queens will participate in pairs in the drag version of the mythical television program "Un, dos, tres". They will have to put on their best competition under the watchful eye of the jury panel, joined by María Pelae. On the catwalk, the queens will have to sell their best look in the category: An illusion.
drag-race-espana.3-9: Try not to laugh with the tortilla challenge! After measuring their resistance with the most viral Tik Tok challenge, the queens will have to face the classic Drag Race maxi challenge. For the make over they will have the participation of workers from the cleaning sector who take care of our streets, hospitals... transforming them into authentic fairy tale princesses. A magical and exciting challenge in which fantasy will be very present. Today we will have Valentina as a guest judge.
drag-race-espana.3-10: The 13 queens of the third season of 'Drag Race España' come face to face to settle some pending accounts and talk about their time on the program. A VIP reunion with very special messages and the election of Miss Congeniality among many other surprises.
drag-race-espana.3-11: The finalists will have the opportunity to review their trajectory on the show on the Supremme De Luxe podcast. To prove that they are deserving of the crown, they will have to write their own verses and prepare choreography for a music video of the iconic Supremme ‘Fiebre'. On the final catwalk there will be a very special reunion. Which queen will become the third winner of Drag Race España?
drag-race-espana.3-12: The four finalists of season 3 have gathered to react live to the Grand Finale in a special episode presented by Samantha Ballentines!
drag-race-espana.4-1: 12 gorgeous queens are ready to show what they are worth. The first challenge in which they can show off will be the Ball, where they will take a trip back in time with their looks.
drag-race-espana.4-2: There are no other eyes like those of Manuela Trasobares, an LGTBIQ+ icon in Spain, so the queens have a mini-challenge to recreate her unique gaze to pay tribute to her. On the catwalk they will have to dazzle the jury in the long-awaited variety show: Supremme Eleganza Talent Extravaganza. And on the catwalk, the category is Baroque!
drag-race-espana.4-3: After proving their worth in opening melons in heels, the queens are getting ready to perform in the most popular series: ‘Aquí no hay quien Diva'. The guest judge who will judge if they are faithful to the spirit of the series is none other than Loles León. After the maxi-rehearsal, the Drag Race España stage will be filled with monsters and creatures from nightmares in the ‘Historias para no dormir' category.
drag-race-espana.4-4: There's nothing like a Zumba class with Leticia Sabater to start the day and get ready for a dance challenge. Pink Chadora, director of the ‘Nuestra Señora del Bocadillo' school, is hosting an end-of-year gala in which the queens must dance in a group as ‘the nerds', ‘the geeks' and ‘the popular ones'. They will have to surprise the guest judge Belén Aguilera. On the catwalk, we pay tribute to our queen of fashion: Ana Locking.
drag-race-espana.4-5: Let's play Snatch Game! After reading the riot act in the classic library, the queens must prepare their best and funniest imitations. The catwalk is dressed in straw, corn, corduroy and denim in the category: ‘Rural Fashion Week', with guest judge Valeria Vegas.
drag-race-espana.4-6: We pay tribute to the great Spanish divas. The queens star in the musical: ETERNAS, where a young woman, in search of her place in the world, will meet the greatest singers in the history of our country. On the catwalk, the queens will have to represent the best of another great Spanish tradition in ‘Soy una Feria' in front of guest judge Melody.
drag-race-espana.4-7: The puppets are back on Drag Race Spain! Because everyone loves to get their hands dirty. Improvisation is the main challenge that the queens face in the sketches they must create for ‘La Draguería del Coleccionista', the most exclusive teleshopping show on television. Fire, Water, Air and Earth are the elements that will make up the dresses on the catwalk where they must leave guest judge Eduardo Navarrete speechless.
drag-race-espana.4-8: After dressing the pit crew, our queens are preparing to accept the award at the MARICHOCHO AWARDS, where they must give a roast speech. They will be accompanied by the judges, comedian Valeria Ros, their beloved sisters who have already been eliminated and, for the first time in the history of Drag Race España, with a live audience! Who was the funniest? Who screwed up? Nothing is decided until they show off their best clothes in the category ‘Touched and not sunk'.
drag-race-espana.4-9: LGTBIQ+ culture is as fundamental as reading, so the queens will be tested to see how much they know about the history and rights of the group. Then it is time for the makeover, in which they will have to become the daughters of the pioneering drag queens in Spain. With their looks and their story they will have to impress the judges, among whom today they have Lola Rodríguez as a guest judge.
drag-race-espana.4-10: The 12 queens of the fourth season of ‘Drag Race España' sit down face to face to read each other the riot act, settle pending accounts and remember their best moments on the show. A reunion with many surprises and VIP messages in which the awards for Miss Congeniality, Miss Lost Look and Miss Makeup will be presented.
drag-race-espana.4-11: Supremme de Luxe has gotten her driving license, so she has decided to invite the finalist queens for a ride in her car while they review their career on the show before starting the final sprint. The winner of Drag Race España will be decided with a lip sync battle, but this time someone other than the judges will vote… Who will be the new Spanish drag superstar?
drag-race-espana.4-12: The final outcome is celebrated for the first time in a theatre, live and with an audience. The 12 queens of the season return to the show with their 'best best drag look'. Chloe Vittu, Le Cocó and Vampirashian will have to defend a complete show with original songs under the watchful eyes of the jury... and the fervour of the fans. Who will be the new Spanish drag superstar?
drag-race-espana.5-1: The race to become the next drag superstar kicks off with a talent show featuring Amaia as a guest judge. On the catwalk, the 12 queens will have to reveal their 'two sides'.
drag-race-espana.5-2: Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi direct the queens in the drag adaptation of ‘El Secreto de Puente Tieso'. Afterwards, they will receive a tribute on the ‘Javi-vision' catwalk.
drag-race-espana.5-3: The ball has arrived! Rossy de Palma receives an iconic tribute and the queens will parade in their best looks from the "Rossy Carpet".
drag-race-espana.5-4: The queens warmed up with a mini twerk challenge before the girl group battle at 'MANIFEST'. Rebeca joined the judging panel, and in her honour, the runway category was named: Enjoying Life.
drag-race-espana.5-5: The library is open! Next up is the snatch game, with Brays Efe and Yenesi as guests. On the catwalk, the category is ‘Al tul tul'.
drag-race-espana.5-6: The queens perform the drag musical version of ‘La casa de Bernarda Alba' before the watchful eyes of the jury and ‘La Dani'. On the catwalk they will pay homage to ‘Bodas de sangre'.
drag-race-espana.5-7: Time to drag watermelons! Afterwards, it's time for the improvisation challenge, with Abril Zamora as our guest. On the catwalk, the category is 'Baraja Española'.
drag-race-espana.5-8: It's time to play '¡Dilo, zorra!'. Afterwards comes the roast, with Martita de Graná as a guest judge. On the catwalk, the category is 'Vestidas para morir'.
drag-race-espana.5-9: The queens will have to earn a place in the final by performing drag for some very special guests, including the ‘Reinas de mi pueblo y Madrina'. The guest judge will be Pastora Soler.
drag-race-espana.5-10: The queens reminisce about the season's best moments. We also chose Miss Simpatía, Miss Look Perdido and Miss Maquillaje.
drag-race-espana.5-11: The finalists open up to Supremme de Luxe at a slumber party. Afterwards, they'll shine in the filming of the 'Bypass' music video and strut their stuff in their best drag looks.
drag-race-espana.0-1: Meet the queens who are competing to snatch the title of Spain's First Drag Superstar! Premieres May 30 on WOW Presents Plus worldwide (excluding Spain) and ATRESplayer PREMIUM in Spain.
drag-race-espana.0-2: Do you want to get to know the 12 queens of Drag Race España T2 in depth? This is the right place. Which of them will get the precious crown? Get your heels ready, Drag Race España is here.
drag-race-espana.0-3: 'Meet the Queens' is the famous program in which the names of the 12 queens participating in this third edition of 'Drag Race España' are announced. Plus, viewers can find out a bit more about them in this special through their early interviews.
drag-race-espana.0-4: Meet the 12 queens taking part in this fourth edition of 'Drag Race Spain', only one of them will manage to become the best drag superstar.
drag-race-espana.0-5: The Grand Grand Final is just around the corner and before the final battle, Chloe Vittu, Vampirashian and Le Cocó look back at the best moments of a season that will go down in history.
drag-race-espana.0-6: Hola hola hola! Drag Race España Season 5 premieres September 28 on WOW Presents Plus
drag-race-espana.6-1: A new stage, a new workroom, new queens—and a king! The sixth season kicks off with a ‘photo-booth' photoshoot, followed by a chance to impress the judges in the classic ‘Talent Show de Luxe.' Get ready for a major ‘Chanelazo' moment! Plus, Supremme de Luxe makes it clear that the lip syncs will remain a matter of life or death—but with a ‘heads or tails' twist.
drag-race-espana.6-2: To get things warmed up, will the queens be able to put on a pair of panties without using their hands? Then, it's time to sew! But this time, they'll have to work in teams. The category is ‘Around the House.' The queens will show off their best "kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom" looks for guest judge Paco Clavel.
drag-race-espana.6-3: The queens will have to guess how much "Granny" paid for iconic pieces worn by previous contestants on 'Drag Race España'. This week's challenge is an acting performance inspired by the legendary Antena 3 series 'Parafarmacia de guardia'. On the catwalk, they'll have to wow the judges, who are joined by actor Carlos González. The theme is: 'The Garden of Earthly Delights'.
drag-race-espana.6-4: The long-awaited ‘girl band' battle has returned to *Drag Race España*. Two iconic groups will go head-to-head, defending their respective tracks: ‘Por la cara' and ‘Vaya Cruz.' Their choreography and dance moves will be evaluated by guest judge Rafa Méndez. Will he give the queens a passing grade, or will he kick them out of class? On the runway, things take on shades of yellow, cyan, and magenta for the category: ‘CMYK Printing.'
drag-race-espana.6-5: It's time for the Snatch Game! The queens must prepare their best impersonations of famous figures to make Supremme de Luxe and some very special guests—‘Las Pilardos'—laugh. On the runway, they will showcase their finest looks under the category ‘Lace in a Box' to impress guest judge Topacio Fresh.
drag-race-espana.6-6: The queens hit the stage for The Golden Brick, a zarzuela-inspired Rusical honoring LGBTQIA+ icon Federico Chueca. Then, they bring masculine fantasy to the runway in the "Iberian Butch" category.
drag-race-espana.0-8: The traditional presentation of the 12 new queens has become the most-watched in its history.

snl-uk.1-1: Tina Fey takes charge of proceedings in the opening edition, with live music from indie rock band Wet Leg.
snl-uk.1-2: Actor Jamie Dornan hosts the comedy sketch and variety show, with live music from London rock band Wolf Alice.
snl-uk.1-3: Actor Riz Ahmed hosts the comedy sketch and variety show, with live music from Leicester rock band Kasabian.
snl-uk.1-4: Actor and comedian Jack Whitehall hosts the sketch and variety show based on the long-running US programme, featuring music by singer-songwriter Jorja Smith.

pluribus.1-1: An astronomer's discovery turns the planet upside down. Carol Sturka, a curmudgeonly novelist, is terrified by this strange new world.
pluribus.1-2: A curiously familiar face introduces Carol to the bizarre new normal. A gathering in Europe brings strangers together…and causes friction.
pluribus.1-3: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.
pluribus.1-4: Carol tests the boundaries of this weirdly honest world at the expense of her ego. Far away, a resolute individual learns he's not alone.
pluribus.1-5: Carol doubles down on her investigation—loneliness be damned. Meanwhile, howls in the night reveal a new source of danger.
pluribus.1-6: Carol shares a horrific discovery and learns new truths in the process. Mr. Diabaté lives life to the fullest in Sin City.
pluribus.1-7: Manousos begins a dangerous trek to meet Carol. Returning home from Las Vegas, Carol gets creative with her rebellion.
pluribus.1-8: Carol takes a different tack with The Others and discovers more than she anticipated. Manousos awakens in unfamiliar surroundings.
pluribus.1-9: Season finale. Manousos arrives in Albuquerque and complications ensue. Carol visits the last best place on Earth.

haunted-hotel.1-1: Desperate to attract paying customers, Katherine hires an exorcist to get rid of the hotel's ghosts. Ben finds an unexpected soul mate.
haunted-hotel.1-2: Katherine is concerned that a rebellious ghost is a bad influence on Esther. A power outage sends Nathan, Ben and Abaddon into the woods.
haunted-hotel.1-3: While Katherine summons the courage to go out on a date, the rest of the crew deals with a creepy killer who targets lusty teens.
haunted-hotel.1-4: Abaddon struggles to control his instincts, Katherine bumps into a business rival, and Nathan, Ben and Esther investigate a possible werewolf.
haunted-hotel.1-5: Esther's plan to become more popular backfires when she starts a dangerous new trend at school. The hotel's honeymoon suite turns on the charm.
haunted-hotel.1-6: A ghost-hunting reality show films an episode at the Undervale. Ben opens up to an enchanted diary and shares all his relationship drama.
haunted-hotel.1-7: Ben's desire to be more confident spawns multiple personalities. Meanwhile, Nathan keeps falling through floors... but why?
haunted-hotel.1-8: A curmudgeonly relative comes to visit — with no plans to leave. Abaddon is outsmarted by a doorstop, and Esther experiments with raising the dead.
haunted-hotel.1-9: Esther takes charge when soul-sucking demons invade the hotel. Katherine shares a painful truth with Nathan about his death.
haunted-hotel.1-10: The good news? There's a busload of red-cloaked customers who want to stay at the Undervale. The bad news? They might be part of a world-ending cult.
haunted-hotel.2-1: With business picking up at the Undervale, Katherine is hiring for help. But can the perfect candidate survive the hotel's frightful working conditions?
haunted-hotel.2-2: Katherine braces for an unwelcome surprise as Ben throws a hauntingly awkward dinner party for Annabelle. Esther and Abaddon's friendship is tested.
haunted-hotel.2-3: While Katherine and the kids reluctantly support a needy witch, Nathan struggles to open up about his afterlife and Abaddon tackles fiendish food prep.
haunted-hotel.2-4: Nathan discovers something to "live" for on a once-in-a-generation night when ghosts can roam free. Katherine stays in with an almost angelic Abaddon.
haunted-hotel.2-5: After an astral projection mishap, Katherine and Shayna must help Esther find her body. Nathan takes Ben and Abaddon to a mermaid-infested lake.
haunted-hotel.2-6: Gunslinging ghosthunter Dante Crowe checks in, dragging the family into a fight against world-ending omens. Abaddon answers the call of the wild.
haunted-hotel.2-7: Nathan faces the horrors of politics as Esther runs his campaign for Ghost Mayor. A multi-limbed concierge lends Katherine a hand — much to Ben's dismay.
haunted-hotel.2-8: To save the Undervale, Katherine must recall her first visit to the hotel, when a living Nathan offered her a place to call home amid marital struggles.

visionquest.1-1: Vision embarks on a journey of self-discovery and finds himself hunted by a deadly force.
visionquest.1-2: Vision comes face to face with his assailant while investigating whether Tommy Shepherd is his son.
visionquest.1-3: Vision and Tommy Shepherd join forces in order to survive while a terrifying killer strikes again.
visionquest.1-4: As Vision confronts a new enemy, Ultron and Tommy Shepherd come face to face.
visionquest.1-5: Ultron and Jocasta join forces. Lisa comes to Vision's aid to help him evade capture.
visionquest.1-6: Vision and Paladin form an uneasy alliance as Thomas finally learns the truth about his past.
visionquest.1-7: Vision and Ultron's twisted relationship comes undone.

drag-race.1-1: On the premiere season of the hit reality television series RuPaul's Drag Race, the first queens to grace the main stage enter the work room where they begin to compete for the crown and title of America's Next Drag Superstar.
drag-race.1-2: The remaining queens form girl groups and divvy up responsibilities including hair, make up, choreography and wardrobe. For the main challenge the dolls lip sync to hit songs by Destiny's Child.
drag-race.1-3: The queens participate in an ode to Oprah and other talk shows and famous interviewers. On the runway the queens share their own drag creations.
drag-race.1-4: In this episode, the remaining queens conceptualize their own Mac Viva Glam PSA. On the runway, the dolls serve calm before being critiqued on their video packages.
drag-race.1-5: The remaining dolls get into the ring with female wrestlers. For the main challenge the queens must transform their fighter into their drag family member.
drag-race.1-6: The final four queens compete in an old school ball challenge sponsored by Absolut Vodka. The queens are each assigned a flavor of Absolut and must then create three looks inspired by one of the following Mango, Citron, Raspberry and Mandarin.
drag-race.1-7: Ru takes us through the highlights, lowlights, and never-before-seen footage from the first six episodes before the finale!
drag-race.1-8: The final three queens write and perform for RuPaul's music video Covergirl. After the queens walk their final runway and a winner is named.
drag-race.1-9: The contestants reunite to discuss what has happened since the competition ended.
drag-race.2-1: Twelve new queens compete to be America's Next Drag Superstar. The queens must reinvent their drag looks using only a set of curtains and household items.
drag-race.2-2: The remaining queens make their own doll, then hit the streets and the club in an all out bootylicious challenge before hitting the runway on the main stage.
drag-race.2-3: The queens chow down on some good ole' southern hospitality before they participate in a commercial campaign for home goods. Then, they hit the runway in their best western wear.
drag-race.2-4: The queens participate in the first ever Snatch Game, where they must impersonate popular figures from pop culture.
drag-race.2-5: The queens participate in a photo challenge featuring the contestants in and out of drag before they hit the runway in their best wedding gown couture.
drag-race.2-6: The queens compete in a rock n roll challenge on the main stage. An emotional lip-sync leaves one queen on the floor.
drag-race.2-7: In the main challenge the queens write and start on the cover of their own book. On the runway, the queens show off their book release press part realness.
drag-race.2-8: The remaining queens are paired with older gay gentlemen who they must transform into their mothers complete with cohesive looks and a sickening performance.
drag-race.2-9: The remaining four queens compete in the Diva Awards, a special awards show just for them. On the runway they must present multiple looks to the judges in the style of a classic NYC ball.
drag-race.2-10: Past queens review RuPaul's Drag Race season 2. Guests include Shannel, Ongina, and many more!
drag-race.2-11: One queen is crowned America's Next Drag Superstar!
drag-race.2-12: The queens of RuPaul's Drag Race season 2 reunite and the claws come out.
drag-race.3-1: The claws come out in the first challenge of the season when the girls are asked to create a holiday look with nothing but some tinsel, ornaments and a few well placed mistletoe.
drag-race.3-2: The queens participate in a psychic challenge. After, they film spoof space films before hitting the runway in their best space themed drag.
drag-race.3-3: The girls get physical as they produce their own inspirational workout videos directed by fitness guru Susan Powter.
drag-race.3-4: The queens get a wake up call in the competition when they're asked to produce two morning news shows.
drag-race.3-5: The queens compete in a star-studded TV game show where they must pull out their best celebrity impersonations.
drag-race.3-6: The queens look good enough to eat in this episode where they're challenged to find fashion inspiration from the world of cakes.
drag-race.3-7: The queens perform stand-up comedy routines in front of a live studio audience!
drag-race.3-8: The queens create patriotic video messages for the troops.
drag-race.3-9: The queens record and perform their own version of Ru's new song, "Superstar", in one of six distinct musical styles!
drag-race.3-10: The queens wig out when they have to compete in a fantasy hair show.
drag-race.3-11: The queens must transform a group of All-American straight jocks into their drag sisters.
drag-race.3-12: The queens break the bank as they perform in a pageant of dresses made out of money.
drag-race.3-13: A look back at the highlights, low-lights and previously unseen footage from the first 13 episodes.
drag-race.3-14: The remaining three queens face their final challenge when they're asked to transform into video vixens for the music video to Ru's latest single, "Champion."
drag-race.3-15: Wigs fly as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season.
drag-race.4-1: In the season 4 premiere, a new crop of queens enter the workroom, participate in an atomic photoshoot then hit the runway in their best post-apocalyptic drag.
drag-race.4-2: The remaining queens participate in a group acting challenge all about wrestling! On the runway, the queens don their most girly-girl drag.
drag-race.4-3: The queens participate in an informercial-style challenge where they must sell one of two albums, Glamazon and Champion. On the runway, the queens dress up in silver and gold.
drag-race.4-4: The queens participate in an acting challenge where they split into two casts and create a spoof of a classic sitcom. On the runway, the queens are asked to dress up for their television premiere.
drag-race.4-5: The queens participate in the infamous Snatch Game, where they must impersonate pop culture celebrities. On the runway they are challenged to dress to impress.
drag-race.4-6: The remaining queens are assigned various colors of the pride flag and must decorate a parade boat to hit the main stage in.
drag-race.4-7: The remaining queens design magazine covers that are sure to sell hot off the press. On the runway, the queens dress for their magazine release party!
drag-race.4-8: The queens participate in a polygraph test. After, the queens participate in a musical challenge where they are paired up with their perfect frenemy.
drag-race.4-9: The remaining queens participate in an election challenge hosted by Dan Savage. After, the dolls hit the runway in their best inaugural drag.
drag-race.4-10: In a shocking twist, one queen is brought back into the competition. After, the remaining queens must turn hot dads into their drag sisters.
drag-race.4-11: The final four must compete in the Fabulous Bitch Ball where they must serve their different looks and perform a musical number in front of the judges.
drag-race.4-12: In this special episode, we take a look back on season 4 of RuPaul's Drag Race.
drag-race.4-13: The final three film a music video for RuPaul's song Glamazon. Then the queens walk the runway in their best drag for their final walk on the main stage.
drag-race.4-14: The queens of season 4 of RuPaul's Drag Race Reunite and a winner is announced!
drag-race.5-1: In the season five premiere, fourteen new drag queens compete for the title of America's Next Drag Superstar with a prize package including a life time supply of Color Evolution cosmetics, a one of a kind trip courtesy of ALandCHUCK.travel, headline Logo's Drag Race tour featuring Absolut Vodka cocktails perfected, and $100,000. In the mini challenge, they have an "underwater serving glamor" photo shoot. In the main challenge, they dumpster dive for materials to create an "award winning look that screams Hollywood red carpet couture" to wear on the runway.
drag-race.5-2: The contestants must lip-synch to the spoken word, as they recreate classic moments from Drag Race history in scene-stealing viral videos.
drag-race.5-3: The queens connect with their inner child as they star in a fun-filled kids TV show!
drag-race.5-4: This week, the queens are challenged to prove their elegance and dancing skills by starring in a ballet based on the life of RuPaul, and on the runway, are asked to present 'extravaganza' looks.
drag-race.5-5: The one we've all been waiting for! The queens compete in a star-studded TV game show that showcases their celebrity impersonations.
drag-race.5-6: The queens test their vocal abilities as they sing in RuPaul's 1980s "We Are The World"-inspired charity single.
drag-race.5-7: The queens' comedy skills are put on the spot as they must roast RuPaul and the celebrity judges in front of a live audience.
drag-race.5-8: The queens create, market and film a commercial for their own signature fragrance, then celebrate with a launch party!
drag-race.5-9: The competition gets spicy as the queens star with Wilmer Valderrama in a sexy Latin telenovela acting challenge
drag-race.5-10: The queens transform gay veterans into gorgeous queens! Then, they perform a patriotic flag salute before walking the runway showing off their new drag mothers and sisters.
drag-race.5-11: The race gets sticky and sweet when the queens compete in a pageant of candy inspired couture.
drag-race.5-12: The top three queens go to court, as Judge Ru presents their final challenge - starring in the music video for RuPaul's hit "The Beginning."
drag-race.5-13: A look back on the highlights, low-lights, and previously unseen footage from the season as we race toward the climactic crowning of America's Next Drag Superstar.
drag-race.5-14: Wigs fly as the queens discuss the drama of the season. Plus, both "America's Next Drag Superstar" and "Miss Congeniality" are crowned
drag-race.6-1: The first half of contestants enter the work room, participate in a photo challenge and hit the runway in television inspired couture.
drag-race.6-2: The second half of contestants enter the workroom, participate in a photo shoot and create couture from celebratory themed boxes.
drag-race.6-3: The remaining queens participate in a horror movie acting challenge after being split into two teams. On the runway the queens don their best drag and stun the judges.
drag-race.6-4: The remaining queens participate in a musical called Shade: The Rusical. After, the contestants take on the runway in their best red carpet gowns.
drag-race.6-5: The remaining queens compete as celebrities in the infamous Snatch Game. On the runway the dolls dress up in RuPaul inspired drag.
drag-race.6-6: The queens make a music video for Oh No She Betta Don't and wear their crazy, sexy cool that accentuate their favourite body part.
drag-race.6-7: On this episode, the remaining queens pair up into teams of two and create advertisements for RuPaul's Glamazon by Colorevolution. Then, the queens stomp the runway in black and white.
drag-race.6-8: The remaining queens participate in a stand up comedy challenge that results in one of the girls becoming emotional.
drag-race.6-9: The remaining contestants host a talk show segment then hit the runway in their best animal inspired drag.
drag-race.6-10: The queens are paired up with men that they must transform into wedding clad drag daughters before giving them away for marriage.
drag-race.6-11: The final five compete in The Glitter Ball where they must show three looks; Banjie Girl Realness, Executive Realness and Glitter Extravaganza.
drag-race.6-12: The final four queens star in RuPaul's 'Sissy That Walk' music video then campaign their reasons for being America's Next Drag Superstar
drag-race.6-13: Take a look back at RuPaul's Drag Race Season 6!
drag-race.6-14: The queens of season 6 of RuPaul's Drag Race reunite and a winner is crowned.
drag-race.7-1: Fourteen new queens enter the work room, walk a spring and winter themed runway, then hit the main stage in their best nude illusion!
drag-race.7-2: In this episode, the queens perform in Glamazonian Airways, a lip syncing group challenge. On the runway the queen show off their best first class jet setting looks.
drag-race.7-3: The queens perform in a Shakespeare-themed acting challenge then hit the main stage in their best bearded looks.
drag-race.7-4: The queens make spoof parody videos of RuPaul hits and stun Michelle in their best green looks.
drag-race.7-5: The queens hit the main stage for an awards show challenge in their best and most glamorous gowns.
drag-race.7-6: The remaining queens act in Ru Hollywood Stories then hit the runway with Death Becomes Her inspired runway.
drag-race.7-7: The remaining dolls compete in the infamous Snatch Game challenge! After, the queens take the runway in leather and lace couture.
drag-race.7-8: In a turn of events, the past eliminated queens come back to the competition to vie for a coveted spot allowing them to return to the competition.
drag-race.7-9: The queens perform in musical versions of cult director John Waters' most iconic films. With guest judges Demi Lovato and John Waters.
drag-race.7-10: The queens are challenged to prance their padded asses off in a live drag dance spectacular. With guest judges Alyssa Milano (Charmed) and comedian Rachael Harris (The Hangover).
drag-race.7-11: This episode, the queens are surprised by Hello Kitty, then compete in a Kitty Girl Ball!
drag-race.7-12: The remaining queens star in RuPaul's music video for Born Naked. After, they show off their best drag to the judges.
drag-race.7-13: Take a look back at RuPaul's Drag Race season 7!
drag-race.7-14: The queens of RuPaul's Drag Race season 7 reunite and one queen is crowned the winner!
drag-race.8-1: Season 8 premieres with the 100th episode and the 100th queen competing to become America's Drag Superstar. The first test is to create an outfit from a legendary design challenge from a past season. Guest judge Nicole Richie.
drag-race.8-2: The queens are challenged to perform in a collegiate, all-queen drag-appella sing-off. With guest judges Ester Dean (Pitch Perfect, Pitch Perfect 2), choreographer Jamal Sims and RuPaul's music producer Lucian Piane.
drag-race.8-3: The queens get their Cookie on in two Empire-inspired scenes. With guest judges Tasha Smith (Empire) and singer-songwriter Faith Evans.
drag-race.8-4: The queens have to sing live in ‘80s style New Wave girl bands. Blondie's Debbie Harry and Chris Stein guest judge, plus RuPaul's music producer Lucian Piane.
drag-race.8-5: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show, and dress in iconic Madonna looks for the runway. With supermodel guest judges Gigi Hadid and Chanel Iman.
drag-race.8-6: The queens give cast members of Little Women: LA drag makeovers in the style of The Wizard of Oz. Fashion designer Marc Jacobs and singer-songwriter Todrick Hall guest judge.
drag-race.8-7: The queens shoot shady presidential campaign ads, throwing their wigs in the ring to become the first drag president of the USA. Vivica A. Fox (Independence Day: Resurgence) and MSNBC Live news anchor Thomas Roberts guest judge.
drag-race.8-8: The queens compete in a pageant of book inspired couture, and perform a musical tribute to Jerri Blank from Strangers With Candy. Siblings Amy Sedaris and David Sedaris guest judge.
drag-race.8-9: The queens compete in their final challenge, starring in the music video for RuPaul's hit "The Realness"; Michelle Visage, Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews judge.
drag-race.8-10: Tensions run high as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season. Plus, both "America's Next Drag Superstar" and "Miss Congeniality" are crowned.
drag-race.9-1: Lady Gaga drops by to meet the 13 new queens competing to become America's Next Drag Superstar. Their first test is to compete in the Miss Charisma Uniqueness Nerve and Talent pageant.
drag-race.9-2: Lisa Kudrow from Friends stops by, and the queens are challenged to perform in an epic cheer battle. With guest judges The B-52s.
drag-race.9-3: The queens must create fairytale drag princesses, and transform themselves into sassy sidekicks. With guest judges Todrick Hall and Cheyenne Jackson.
drag-race.9-4: The queens join the cutthroat Morning Talk Show wars. Naya Rivera (Glee) and Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman guest judge.
drag-race.9-5: Todrick Hall directs the queens in Broadway's newest mega-sensation, the Kardashian musical. Singer Meghan Trainor guest judges.
drag-race.9-6: The Queens impersonate celebrities in a TV game show. Candis Cayne and Denis O'Hare guest judge.
drag-race.9-7: The queens act in a classic '90s high-school drama directed by original "Beverly Hills 90210" stars Tori Spelling and Jennie Garth.
drag-race.9-8: The queens perform a comedy roast on Michelle Visage in front of a live audience. Singer Tamar Braxton and Fortune Feimster (The Mindy Project) guest judge.
drag-race.9-9: The queens create, write, and star in their own TV pilots. Noah Galvin (The Real O'Neals) and QVC queen Lisa Robertson guest judge.
drag-race.9-10: The six remaining drag queens were asked by RuPaul to give make-overs of themselves, and six crew members of RuPaul's Drag Race.
drag-race.9-11: The queens must participate in the Gayest Ball Ever and create three different outfits based off three categories: Rainbow-She-Betta-Do, Sexy Unicorn and Village People Eleganza Extravaganza.
drag-race.9-12: The four remaining drag queens were asked by RuPaul to write, produce and choreograph an original verse for the remix of his song "Category Is"; additionally, each queen were ask to guest star on RuPaul's podcast What's the Tee?, featuring panel judge Michelle Visage.
drag-race.9-13: In a reunion episode, the contestants reminisce over the season and Miss Congeniality is announced!
drag-race.9-14: The final four contestants lip-sync in groups of two to see who will become America's Next Drag Superstar.
drag-race.10-1: Christina Aguilera stunts on the mainstage. Plus, fan favorite queens from the past decade of Drag Race return as 14 new queens compete to become America's Next Drag Superstar and win $100,000.
drag-race.10-2: The queens perform a dance number with some lip-syncing that is inspired by pharmaceutical TV ads.
drag-race.10-3: The queens create and star in commercials for new Drag-themed dating apps.
drag-race.10-4: The queens cook up global warming friendly looks for the last ball ever.
drag-race.10-5: The queens' improv skills are put to the test for a new talk show, "Bossy Rossy," hosted by Ross Mathews.
drag-race.10-6: The queens have to produce and host their very own Drag Con panels on Makeup, Hair and Body. Kumail Nanjiani and Emily Gordon, the husband-and-wife duo behind the Oscar-nominated film "The Big Sick," guest judge.
drag-race.10-7: The queens must impersonate their favorite celebrities for the legendary Snatch Game. Audra McDonald and Kate Upton guest judge; Bianca Del Rio and Alex Trebek are special guests.
drag-race.10-8: The queens pay tribute to one of the greatest stars of all time in "Cher: The Unauthorized Rusical."
drag-race.10-9: The queens are assigned parts and must act in the new hit series, "Breastworld". Broad City stars Ilana Glazer and Abbi Jacobson guest judge; Randy Rainbow and Steven Colbert are special guests.
drag-race.10-10: The queens give drag makeovers to social media superstars.
drag-race.10-11: The queens present two characters on the runway.
drag-race.10-12: The top four queens must write and perform a verse in a performance of RuPaul's hit single, 'American', and guest on RuPaul's podcast with Michelle Visage.
drag-race.10-13: One week from the Grand Finale, all Season 10 queens return to discuss the season's gaggiest moments. Includes never-before-seen footage, jaw-dropping revelations, and a recap of the seasons' most amazing looks.
drag-race.10-14: RuPaul crowns America's Next Drag Superstar in an epic lip-sync smack-down for the crown.
drag-race.11-1: Miley Cyrus goes undercover in the workroom to spy on the new cast of queens competing for $100,000. The first test is to create signature looks from materials belonging to former Drag Race legends.
drag-race.11-2: The queens must act in drag queen versions of recent Black Empowerment blockbuster movies. Actors Sydelle Noel (Black Panther) and Bobby Moynihan (Saturday Night Live) guest judge.
drag-race.11-3: The queens put their pop icon knowledge to the test when they have to perform in diva worship talk shows; actor Troye Sivan ("Boy Erased") and actor Guillermo Diaz ("Scandal") guest judge.
drag-race.11-4: The queens get political in a "Grease" inspired musical set in the "Trump School For Girls". Rachel Maddow makes a guest appearance, while Tiffany "New York" Pollard and Joel McHale guest judge.
drag-race.11-5: The queens compete in a spooky pageant of monster inspired couture and showcase three Halloween inspired looks. Supermodel Cara Delevingne and pop culture icon Elvira guest judge.
drag-race.11-6: The queens get physical in the 69th International Draglympics. Choreographer Travis Wall and Olympian figure skaters Mirai Nagasu and Adam Rippon guest judge. Camp aerobicize queen Love Connie makes a guest appearance.
drag-race.11-7: The queens use organic ingredients to create sickening but sustainable high fashion looks. Supermodel Amber Valletta and reality star Kandi Burruss guest judge. Drag queen Alyssa Edwards makes a guest appearance.
drag-race.11-8: The queens compete in a nautical-themed version of the legendary Snatch Game. Veep co-stars Tony Hale and Clea DuVall guest judge. Drag queen Jinkx Monsoon makes a guest appearance.
drag-race.11-9: The queens clash with the law in the hit TV series "Los Angeles Drag Patrol". Natasha Lyonne (Russian Doll), Cheyenne Jackson (American Horror Story) and Fortune Feimster (The Mindy Project) guest judge.
drag-race.11-10: The queens must razzle and dazzle in their very own magic show. Gina Rodriguez (Jane the Virgin) and Katherine Langford (13 Reasons Why) guest judge.
drag-race.11-11: The queens makeover returning queens, transforming them into a member of their own drag family. Lena Waithe (The Chi) and comedian Wanda Sykes guest judge.
drag-race.11-12: The queens must write and record a verse in a performance of RuPaul's hit single "Queens Everywhere", and guest on RuPaul's podcast with Michelle Visage. Choreographer Todrick Hall, style superstar Carson Kressley and Ross Matthews guest judge.
drag-race.11-13: One episode away from the Grand Finale, the contestants return to discuss the season's gaggiest moments.
drag-race.11-14: RuPaul crowns America's next drag superstar in an epic lip-sync smack-down for the crown.
drag-race.12-1: Seven queens enter the work room, composing of Brita, Nicky Doll, Widow Von'Du, Jackie Cox, Heidi N. Closet, Gigi Goode, and Crystel Methyd. RuPaul announces the first mini-challenge is to present two sets of runway looks: one for spring and one for fall, akin to Season 7's first mini-challenge.
drag-race.12-2: In the second season premiere, the queens must write and perform a Fosse-inspired jazz number. Thandie Newton (Westworld) and Swedish singer Robyn guest judge.
drag-race.12-3: For the first time this season, someone will sashay away! The queens must flex their comedy improv skills for the new TV show "World's Worst" - a talent show for people with little talent. Olivia Munn (X-Men: Apocalypse) guest judges.
drag-race.12-4: The queens compete in a pageant of sports-inspired couture, and showcase three ball-themed looks. Leslie Jones (Saturday Night Live) guest judges.
drag-race.12-5: The queens are challenged to overact in TV's longest running drag queen scripted show, "Gay's Anatomy." Singer and dancer Normani guest judges.
drag-race.12-6: The queens impersonate celebrities in the legendary Snatch Game. Mean Girls co-stars Jonathan Bennett and Daniel Franzese guest judge. Drag queen Miss Vanjie makes a guest appearance.
drag-race.12-7: The queens get into the groove in a Queen of Pop inspired musical. U.S. Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and supermodel Winnie Harlow guest judge.
drag-race.12-8: The queens must create and market ridiculously extravagant products, for the new drag queen lifestyle brand "Droop." Chaka Khan guest judges. Personal trainer Bob Harper makes a guest appearance.
drag-race.12-9: It's time for America's first drag queen president! The queens argue in a fabulous presidential debate. Actors Jeff Goldblum (Jurassic Park) and Rachel Bloom (Crazy Ex-Girlfriend) guest judge.
drag-race.12-10: The queens must makeover Drag Race superfans. But there's one thing… the superfans have no idea what's about to happen to them. Actress Daisy Ridley (Rey in Star Wars) guest judges.
drag-race.12-11: The queens must create and perform their own solo show. Whoopi Goldberg (The View; Ghost) coaches the queens and guest judges.
drag-race.12-12: The queens must perform a medley of songs from RuPaul's Drag Race Live!, a hit show that is wowing audiences on the Las Vegas strip. Choreographer Jamal Sims (Disney's Aladdin) guest judges.
drag-race.12-13: One episode away from the Grand Finale, the contestants reunite virtually to discuss the season's gaggiest moments.
drag-race.12-14: The Top 3 face off virtually in a lip sync smackdown for $100,000 and the title of America's Next Drag Superstar. Miss Congeniality is also crowned.
drag-race.13-1: After making their werk room entrances, the queens face off in a series of Lip Sync for Your Life battles.
drag-race.13-2: After the first contestant of the season is voted out, the queens stomp the runway in a fashion show, then perform a special version of RuPaul's song "Condragulations."
drag-race.13-3: The previously chopped queens return to walk in a fashion runway show, then perform a choreographed number to RuPaul's song "Phenomenon," and comedian Nicole Byer guest judges.
drag-race.13-4: After the queens come together for the first time, RuPaul hosts a holiday movie marathon featuring Hallmark Channel-inspired parodies, and Loni Love sits in with the judges.
drag-race.13-5: The queens create three different bag-inspired couture lewks for RuPaul's Bag Ball, and comedian Nicole Byer joins the judges' panel.
drag-race.13-6: The queens perform in a disco documentary that chronicles the different phases of the dance phenomenon, the category on the runway is Little Black Dress, and Loni Love guest judges.
drag-race.13-7: The queens read each other for filth in the Reading Challenge and improvise as guests on Ross Mathews's trashy talk show, "Bossy Rossy After Dark," and Ts Madison sits in the with the judges.
drag-race.13-8: The queens get performance advice from Anne Hathaway and star in a social media-influenced musical, and choreographer Jamal Sims sits in with the judges.
drag-race.13-9: Before walking the runway in Fascinating Fascinators, the queens bring out their best celebrity impressions for Snatch Game, and Ts Madison sits in with the judges.
drag-race.13-10: The queens are paired up by psychic Char Margolis and challenged to make over their partners as their own drag doppelgangers, and Loni Love joins the judges.
drag-race.13-11: The queens compete in a RuPaul's Drag Race-themed trivia game, write and star in commercials for their own self-branded sodas, and walk the runway in Beast Couture.
drag-race.13-12: The queens roast past Miss Congeniality winners Heidi N Closet, Nina West and Valentina, special guest Norvina stops by, and comedian Loni Love sits in with the judges.
drag-race.13-13: The queens get acting advice from Scarlett Johansson before starring in a sci-fi spoof, then walk the runway in Haute Pockets couture, and Cynthia Erivo joins the judges.
drag-race.13-14: Before heading into the grand finale, the Top Four queens record a verse to the song "Lucky," choreograph a performance with Jamal Sims and sit for an interview with RuPaul and Michelle Visage.
drag-race.13-15: In this virtual reunion, the eliminated queens share music video performances, the Top Four answer revealing questions, RuPaul gets the backstage tea, and two lip-sync assassins face off.
drag-race.13-16: The Top Four queens compete in a Britney Spears-themed lip sync smackdown, Heidi N Closet reveals Season 13's Miss Congeniality winner, and RuPaul crowns America's Next Drag Superstar.
drag-race.14-1: Lizzo guest judges part one of the Season 14 premiere, and a new set of queens stars in a dizzying photo shoot, performs in a talent show and walks the runway in Signature Showstopping Drag.
drag-race.14-2: Alicia Keys guest judges in part two of the Season 14 premiere, which features a second set of queens making their werk room debuts, posing in a photoshoot and performing in a talent show.
drag-race.14-3: RuPaul announces a twist in the lip sync elimination process, the queens serve lewks during two different balls, and reality TV star and producer Christine Chiu sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-4: The queens star in self-produced Season 14 teaser trailers, Jennifer Lopez sends the girls a message before the Night of a Thousand JLos runway, and Loni Love sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-5: First-eliminated queens from past seasons return to star in parody PSA commercials, the category on the runway is Spring Has Sprung, and singer Ava Max sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-6: The queens repurpose unconventional materials from Glamazon Prime shipping boxes into high-fashion runway looks, and Taraji P. Henson sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-7: The queens star in the over-the-top soap opera "The Daytona Wind" and serve Chaps on the Runway, and Ts Madison sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-8: The queens read each other for filth, write and perform 60s girl group-inspired songs and pour their hearts into their runway lewks, and comedian Alec Mapa sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-9: The queens form DragCon panels to discuss the topic of men -- from toxic males to accepting dads -- and go big with shoulder pads on the runway, and Nicole Byer sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-10: Actress Dove Cameron and Season 3 winner Raven guest star on Snatch Game as the queens try out their best celebrity impersonations, and the category is Holy Couture on the runway.
drag-race.14-11: After a particularly disappointing Snatch Game, seven queens must face off in a Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown as DeJa Skye, the only safe contestant, watches from the werk room.
drag-race.14-12: Leslie Jordan directs the queens in a "Moulin Rouge" parody musical; the category on the runway is Mirror, Mirror; and the judges welcome Andra Day to the panel.
drag-race.14-13: Anastasia Beverly Hills President Norvina stops by as the queens paint the faces of RuPaul and Dolly Parton on a mural, Ross Mathews gets roasted, and Dulcé Sloan sits in with the judges.
drag-race.14-14: For their final challenge, the Top Five queens design costumes, learn choreography and write song lyrics for their music video debuts in RuPaul's "Catwalk."
drag-race.14-15: The queens dish on the competition, including Daya Betty's controversial comments, Kornbread "The Snack" Jeté's shocking exit and some good old-fashioned reading.
drag-race.14-16: It's showtime for the final five queens as they compete for the title of America's next drag superstar in original musical performances and a series of lip sync battles.
drag-race.15-1: All-new queens make their debut in the werk room, kicking off Season 15 with a photo shoot and a musical number to introduce a talent show, and Ariana Grande returns to guest judge.
drag-race.15-2: For the Season 15 premiere talent show, the queens flaunt their unique skills and then walk the runway in looks that show their personal styles, and pop superstar Ariana Grande guest judges.
drag-race.15-3: In this heavenly acting challenge, the queens must create infomercials for a queer afterlife. Country singer Maren Morris and LQBT activist Ts Madison guest judge.
drag-race.15-4: Ru serves up a double helping of the celebrity impersonation game show, with the queens playing in two rounds, with two different casts of characters. Amandla Stenberg (The Hate U Give) guest judges.
drag-race.15-5: The queens must turn home decor into haute couture; actress Janelle Monae guest judges.
drag-race.15-6: The queens fast forward 50 years to perform in old lady girl groups, singing about life, love, and growing old with your besties; actress and comedian Megan Stalter guest judges.
drag-race.15-7: The queens exchange flatulence for canned laughter, as the melodramatic acting challenge returns in sitcom form. Actor Harvey Guillén (What We Do in the Shadows) guest judges.
drag-race.15-8: The queens put their charisma and choreography to the test in a Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown, where they compete in a series of eight lip sync battles that will culminate in one elimination.
drag-race.15-9: Drag Race celebrates its milestone 200th episode. The queens design outfits featuring the 15 year anniversary gift: crystal. Julia Garner (Inventing Anna; Ozark) guest judges.
drag-race.15-10: The queens get up close and personal with celebrities for TV's sketchiest newsmagazine, 50/50; the runway, category is Night Of 1000 Beyoncés; special guests Charo, Frankie Grande and Love Connie.
drag-race.15-11: The queens perform stand-up comedy in pairs, but an odd number of queens causes for some drama. Comedian Ali Wong (Ali Wong: Baby Cobra) guest judges.
drag-race.15-12: This season's Rusical is set in the small town of West Bumtuck, where drag has been outlawed. An underground alliance forms to try and defeat the bigots. Country music sensation Orville Peck guest judges.
drag-race.15-13: The queens give drag makeovers to hard-working teachers, from kindergarten to high school. Queer pop musician Hayley Kiyoko guest judges.
drag-race.15-14: The final queens collab with RuPaul on a remix of his song "Blame It On The Edit," recording their own verses and creating a space-themed music video.
drag-race.15-15: The queens of Season 15 reunite ahead of the finale to discuss the competition, react to controversial moments, watch unaired footage and weigh in on how drag is attacked in politics.
drag-race.15-16: In the Season 15 grand finale, RuPaul looks back over the queens' journeys and crowns America's next drag superstar.
drag-race.16-1: The first seven queens of Season 16 pull double duty as contestants and critics as they rank each other's talent show performances and ru-vealing runways, and Charlize Theron guest judges.
drag-race.16-2: The second set of Season 16 queens make their introductions before performing and judging each other in a talent show, and singer Becky G is a guest judge.
drag-race.16-3: All the Season 16 queens meet in the werk room for the first time before showcasing their design skills with three mother-themed looks on the runway, and designer Isaac Mizrahi guest judges.
drag-race.16-4: The queens are challenged to serve up big laughs on a live late-night sketch comedy show, and actress Sarah Michelle Gellar joins as a guest judge.
drag-race.16-5: The queens are tasked with writing and performing their own verses for songs from RuPaul's album "Black Butta," and Swedish synth-pop duo Icona Pop guest judge.
drag-race.16-6: After a flamenco dance with Spanish sensation Charo, the queens must design their own dolls based on their drag personas, and stylist Law Roach guest judges.
drag-race.16-7: This season's rusical is set high in the Swish Alps as a young queen named Mariah goes in search of a musical outlet for her inner freak, and director Adam Shankman guest judges.
drag-race.16-8: After the Reading Challenge and a visit from show alum Chad Michaels, the queens impersonate celebrities in the classic Snatch Game, and actress Kyra Sedgwick guest judges.
drag-race.16-9: Morticia meets Mugler as the queens create a neo-goth look from scratch using only black, white and gray fabric, and model and actress Kaia Gerber guest judges.
drag-race.16-10: The queens let their voices be heard in an inspirational political anthem and exercise their right to shake their groove thing, and choreographer Jamal Sims guest judges.
drag-race.16-11: The queens must devise and present comical Drag Awareness seminars in front of a live audience of corporate employees, and actor and comedian Joel Kim Booster guest judges.
drag-race.16-12: Nature calls as the queens star in the hot new design show "Bathroom Hunties," decorating and showcasing over-the-top powder rooms, and actress Mayan Lopez guest judges.
drag-race.16-13: Hunky male dancers from the RuPaul's Drag Race LIVE! show in Las Vegas drop by the werk room to be made over into devastating drag queens, and country star Kelsea Ballerini guest judges.
drag-race.16-14: The queens dig deep to write their memoirs, pose for a book cover photo shoot, and get grilled by podcaster Matt Rogers, and journalist and author Ronan Farrow guest judges.
drag-race.16-15: All the eliminated queens return to battle it out in a LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown, with nine lip syncs and a cash prize of $50,000 on the line.
drag-race.16-16: The top queens face off in an epic evening of performances and lip syncs as they compete for the title of America's Next Drag Superstar and a grand prize of $200,000.
drag-race.17-1: Drag Race is back, doing what it does best: parodying the buzziest reality shows on TV. A new cast of queens must survive a deadly game of "Ru Light, Green Light," before showing off their skills in a talent show. Superstar Katy Perry guest judges.
drag-race.17-2: Part 2 of the epic two part premiere. The second half of the new cast of 14 queens, competing to be crowned America's Next Drag Superstar, must show off their performance skills in a talent show. Rapper and singer Doechii guest judges.
drag-race.17-3: The queens take fashion inspiration from the board game Monopoly and must create from scratch an outfit that screams that they own everything; actress and comedian Sandra Bernhard becomes a guest judge.
drag-race.17-4: The queens receive the task of singing songs based on memorable moments from "Drag Race" history; actress Julia Schlaepfer guest judges.
drag-race.17-5: Live from Tuckahoe, it's RDR Live! The queens are challenged to serve up laughs in a hilarious send-up of the iconic sketch comedy show. Actor, writer and director Paul W. Downs (Hacks, Broad City) guest judges.
drag-race.17-6: Tensions rise as the queens put their design skills to the test in a pageant of ocean-inspired couture and showcase three fishy looks; actress and model Hunter Schafer and stylist Law Roach guest judge.
drag-race.17-7: The queens impersonate celebrities in the classic quick-fire comedy game show. Global All Stars winner Alyssa Edwards drops by the werkroom; actress and comedian Quinta Brunson (Abbott Elementary) guest judges.
drag-race.17-8: This season's Rusical is inspired by a mashup of "Wicked, The Wizard of Oz" and "The Wiz." Jamal Sims choreographs the queens; singer Adam Lambert guest judges.
drag-race.17-9: After the iconic Reading challenge, the queens rock out with their frocks out, as they create a look worthy of a Betsey Johnson fashion collection. The fashion icon herself, Betsey Johnson, guest judges.
drag-race.17-10: The queens pay a comedy tribute to three of the shadiest queens in Drag Race herstory: Kandy Muse, Mistress Isabelle Brooks, and Plane Jane. Comedian Whitney Cummings guest judges.
drag-race.17-11: As a tribute to Truman Capote and his Swans, the queens must act up a storm in a high camp tale of betrayal. Cheyenne Jackson (American Horror Story) directs; singer Sam Smith guest judges.
drag-race.17-12: The queens share hilarious and heartwarming true stories in a performance challenge with a twist: their partners must act out the stories through interpretive dance. Jerrod Carmichael (Jerrod Carmichael Reality Show) guest judges.
drag-race.17-13: The queens make over some extra special drag newbies: their moms and dads. June Diane Raphael (Grace and Frankie) guest judges.
drag-race.17-14: The queens audition to star in RuPaul's Drag Race LIVE! at Flamingo Las Vegas. Tracee Ellis Ross (black-ish) guest judges.
drag-race.17-15: All of the eliminated queens return to battle it out in a Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown, with eight lip syncs, and a cash prize of $50,000 on the line.
drag-race.17-16: The top queens face off in an epic evening of performances and lip syncs, as they compete for a grand prize of $200,000. Superstar Liza Minnelli joins RuPaul on stage.
drag-race.0-1: What does it really take to become America's next drag superstar? From fabulous divas to outrageous flops, RuPaul gives a behind-the-scenes look at casting for Drag Race.
drag-race.0-2: Meet the queens of season 8 before the Drag Race ru-turns in 2016.
drag-race.0-4: The wait is over. The RuVolution starts TODAY! Watch the #DragRace Season 12 RuVeal with Yvie Oddly now.
drag-race.0-5: Welcome to an unSPOOKable evening of tricks, treats, and tucks! Celebrate the spirit of Halloween by tipping your favorite Queens of RuPaul's Drag Race season 12. All donations will be divided up evenly and distributed directly to the Queens. We will be taking donations through Venmo, PayPal, and Cash App. Now…bring back my Ghouls!
