taskmaster.21-3: Alex Horne treats the contestants to a song, but not everyone appreciates it. Kumail Nanjiani embraces Amy Gledhill and Joel Dommett while they ask him questions about a horse. Joanna Page reveals her favourite childhood tipple, and Armando Iannucci goes for an ice cream.
taskmaster.21-4: Greg Davies judges the competence of five comics in tasks involving a cloche, a jar of dice and giant pencils. Joanna Page holds a sheep above her head, Amy Gledhill bursts a balloon in the lab and Kumail Nanjiani gives an ostrich some fangs. Elsewhere, Armando Iannucci and Joel Dommett both find unusual substitutes for sweets, while the normally infallible Alex Horne makes a rare error.
taskmaster.21-5: As the series reaches its halfway point, the Taskmaster is starting to know what to expect from his current crop of comics. But even he's surprised by the outrage Armando Iannucci causes with an ostrich, how Amy Gledhill struggles to remember the word for 'tube', and what Kumail Nanjiani does to time itself. Meanwhile, Joel Dommett has hours of fun with pots and pans, and Joanna Page and Alex Horne have an intimate conversation about guinea pigs while they wait for Armando to come and join them.
taskmaster.21-6: The heated contest continues as Armando Iannucci douses a coconut in vinegar while Joel Dommett slathers another in glue. Amy Gledhill gets creative with a series of spoons. Kumail Nanjiani impresses everyone with his extraordinarily strong jaw, and Little Alex Horne causes Joanna Page to scream in such terror that it sparks alarm in the local area.
taskmaster.21-7: Things become a little strange in the Taskmaster house as Armando Iannucci and Joanna Page contemplate an alien invasion, Joel Dommett joyfully slides socks onto cacti, Kumail Nanjiani is enchanted by smoky bubbles, and Amy Gledhill performs stand-up using items of clothing. Meanwhile, Greg Davies proves that he's a responsible master of his loveable pet, Little Alex Horne.
taskmaster.21-8: In a departure from the generally friendly tone of the show, Alex Horne and Joel Dommett trade insults across tasks. But name-calling is the least of the Taskmaster's worries as he witnesses Joanna Page doing something startling with a pineapple, Armando Iannucci doing something confusing with a nursery rhyme and Amy Gledhill doing something unexpected with balls of ice. Meanwhile, Kumail Nanjiani reveals something unusual about his body.
taskmaster.21-9: It's the penultimate episode of the series, and four contestants still harbour realistic hopes of becoming the 21st Taskmaster champion... while Joel Dommett's just having a really good time! Little Alex Horne is delighted to be put in charge of a flip-flop flinging machine, as well as recording events such as Amy Gledhill wringing out a poached egg, Kumail Nanjiani planking and Joanna Page doubting wind power. Meanwhile, Armando Iannucci shows why it's important not to curtail his nap time.
taskmaster.21-10: It's the grand final, and at the end of this episode, one of our five fabulous competitors will walk away with a trophy that looks very little like Greg Davies tucked under their arm. But before that, Amy Gledhill literally tears her hair out, Armando Iannucci plays the recorder while riding a trike with a plunger on his head, Joel Dommett sniffs the contents of a vacuum, Kumail Nanjiani mistreats a beloved resident of the Taskmaster house and Joanna Page lays waste to Little Alex Horne. Plus: the greatest pillow fights of all time!
taskmaster.0-1: John Hannah, Krishnan Guru-Murthy, Nicola Coughlan, Rylan Clark-Neal and Shirley Ballas attempt a series of silly tasks, in a one-off new year special hosted by Greg Davies and Alex Horne
taskmaster.0-2: Greg Davies and his elf Alex Horne present a festive special, as Adrian Chiles, Claudia Winkleman, Jonnie Peacock, Lady Leshurr and Sayeeda Warsi contend with eggs, vinegar and a long pole.
taskmaster.0-3: Amelia Dimoldenberg, Carol Vorderman, Greg James, Mo Farah and Self Esteem compete in this one-off event, featuring lots of dots and countless carp pellets, to win Greg Davies' eyebrows.
taskmaster.0-4: Who's best at scoffing poppadoms? Deborah Meaden, Kojey Radical, Lenny Rush, Steve Backshall or Zoe Ball? Greg Davies and Little Alex Horne are determined to find out.
taskmaster.0-5: Gathering an eclectic mix of well-known faces from all corners of the entertainment world, Alex Horne and Greg Davies will put them through their paces in the name of festive cheer.Which of these stars, each renowned in their fields, will impress the Taskmaster the most and ring in the new year grabbing Greg's golden eyebrows, the most coveted prize in all of showbiz?
taskmaster.0-6: Your 2,000,000 subscriber treat is here - filmed over a week at Pinewood Studios in May 2025, join Little Alex and the TM team for a tour of the Taskmaster studio as we go behind the scenes of Series/Season 20.
taskmaster.0-7: In Taskmaster's annual new year celebration, five new contestants from outside the world of comedy compete to win Greg Davies' much-coveted golden eyebrows trophy. And for the first time ever, this New Year Treat takes place over two episodes, which means contestants have twice the opportunity to impress Greg with their brilliance - and a double possibility of making him really cross with their incompetence. The five stout-hearted stars who believe they can take on the Taskmaster's baffling tasks are: Big Zuu, Jill Scott, Sam Ryder, Susie Dent and Rose Ayling-Ellis. How will they fare when the
taskmaster.0-8: With just three points separating the celebs, it's all to play for in the second leg. Big Zuu gets competitive with a shoe. And can Susie Dent make Alex Horne's dream come true?
taskmaster.22-1: Richard Ayoade, Isy Suttie, Matt Lucas, Nina Conti and Chloe Petts leave their dignity at the door to take part in the comedy show, beginning with challenges that see them hunting for golden apples, rearranging furniture and performing duets - with themselves. Alex Horne keeps an eye on their progress, while Greg Davies sums up their performances and hands out the points.
taskmaster.22-2: Five plucky comics take on a variety of puzzling, creative and often pointless tasks set by Taskmaster Greg Davies and administered by his loyal little assistant, Little Alex Horne. The courageous quintet crawling through tunnels, looking for faces in toast and making use of their armpits in the name of art are: Chloe Petts, Isy Suttie, Matt Lucas, Nina Conti and Richard Ayoade.
taskmaster.22-3: In between contributions from former contestants and relatives of current contestants, this episode will answer many questions, including: can Matt Lucas conquer his vertigo? Where did Chloe Petts find such a giant syringe? And why is Alex Horne flopping about in flippers and butterfly wings? Greg Davies dishes out points when they're deserved and withholds them when they're not as he tries to make sense of Nina Conti filling her face with citrus fruits, Isy Suttie locating her saliva on Alex's jacket and Richard Ayoade chucking a doll's head at a gargoyle.
taskmaster.22-4: Greg Davies yells about a famously vast work of art, but how will the contestants react? And what have hippos got to do with it? Meanwhile, Little Alex Horne enjoys watching all five comics look under lots of tables, with varying levels of desperation. Richard Ayoade has a concerning call with his agent, Chloe Petts sticks googly eyes to a body part, and Isy Suttie insists it's time to make steam.
taskmaster.22-5: Isy Suttie unexpectedly mentions eggs, Matt Lucas stares hard at the ceiling, Nina Conti gets very clever in a test, Chloe Petts hides an object somewhere Alex Horne wouldn't dare look, and Richard Ayoade gives the slight impression that he finds some of the tasks a bit irritating. But why is Greg Davies wearing a white glove?
taskmaster.22-6: Isy Suttie unexpectedly mentions eggs, Matt Lucas stares hard at the ceiling, Nina Conti gets very clever in a test, Chloe Petts hides an object somewhere Alex Horne wouldn't dare look, and Richard Ayoade gives the slight impression that he finds some of the tasks a bit irritating. But why is Greg Davies wearing a white glove?
taskmaster.22-7: A former contestant makes an unexpected and dramatic return to the Taskmaster house, but will the current cast give them the respect they undoubtedly deserve?
taskmaster.22-8: Richard Ayoade causes controversy while wearing a blindfold, Isy Suttie reveals her revolutionary counting method, Nina Conti invents a new word, Matt Lucas briefly turns into an old-school railwayman, and Chloe Petts is the first contestant in Taskmaster history to draw blood while avoiding flying sausages. Meanwhile, Alex Horne is very excited to unveil his brand-new science machine. Greg Davies is less interested.
taskmaster.22-9: Matt Lucas decides to cut the Taskmaster down to size. Nina Conti repeatedly insults a citrus fruit, and Alex Horne delights in making everyone wear aprons.
taskmaster.22-10: It's the grand final and there's only one question left to be answered: how much leg hair does Little Alex Horne have? No, sorry: who is the 22nd Taskmaster champion?

breaking-bad.1-1: A high-school chemistry teacher (Bryan Cranston) is diagnosed with a deadly cancer, so he puts his expertise to use and teams with an ex-student (Aaron Paul) to manufacture top-grade crystal meth in hopes of providing for his family after he's gone.
breaking-bad.1-2: After the accident in the desert, Walter and Jesse need to dispose of the unfortunate mess in their rolling lab of an RV, and Skyler begins to suspect that Walter and Jesse are involved in some mysterious goings-on.
breaking-bad.1-3: Walter and Jesse fight about the latter's drug use, so he leaves, forcing Walter to deal with their captive, Krazy-8 (Max Arciniega); Hank uses scared-straight tactics with Walter Jr. when his aunt suspects he's smoking pot; Skyler is furious when Walter stays away from home.
breaking-bad.1-4: Walter announces to the family that he has cancer; the DEA believes there is a new big-time player in the Albuquerque drug business; a depressed Walter takes his anger out on a worthy recipient; Jesse pays a surprise visit to his parents' house.
breaking-bad.1-5: At a birthday party for a successful former science colleague, Walter is offered a job; Jesse tries gaining legitimate employment but winds up back cooking meth, and an inferior kind at that; Skyler assembles the family for an intervention to get Walter to agree to chemotherapy, but he's concerned about quality-of-life issues and their financial difficulties.
breaking-bad.1-6: Walter, in the throes of his chemotherapy treatment and needing money more than ever, agrees to cook more crystal meth with Jesse; Skinny Pete hooks Jesse up with an important new contact, while the DEA intensifies its investigation of Albuquerque's new drug kingpin.
breaking-bad.1-7: Walter and Jesse do business with a new partner-in-crime, but immediately run into "production problems," which necessitates a nearly impossible mission to knock off a chemical-supply house. Meanwhile, Marie throws a baby shower for Skyler and presents her with an unusual gift that shows a different side of the aunt-to-be.
breaking-bad.2-1: Season 2 kicks off with Walt and Jesse once again bearing witness to Tuco's incendiary disposition, which leads them to the conclusion that it's time to put an end to their business dealings with him. But the question is how. Meanwhile, Hank serves as a go-between for estranged sisters Skyler and Marie.
breaking-bad.2-2: Trying to dissociate themselves from the volatile Tuco takes a bad turn when Walt and Jesse get trapped with the dealer, and Skyler, worried about her missing husband, receives comfort from her sister and brother-in-law. Hank, meanwhile, pays a business call on Jesse's mother.
breaking-bad.2-3: Walt and Jesse attempt to cover their tracks and distance themselves from Tuco, but they soon find that business is taking a hit along with their financial situation. Meanwhile, Hank and his DEA investigation into the meth ring get a major break that just might put Walt and Jesse in their crosshairs.
breaking-bad.2-4: Despite Walt's attempt to reconnect with the family, a suspicious Skyler keeps him at arm's length and worries about what he's been up to while he's been away from the house; Jesse finds himself on the streets once again and struggles to improve his lot in life.
breaking-bad.2-5: Hank deals with some lingering aftereffects from his confrontation with Tuco; bills are piling up at the White house and tensions are beginning to run high; Jesse organizes a crew of dealers to take their product to the streets.
breaking-bad.2-6: Walt returns to teaching at the high school; when Skinny Pete gets taken advantage of and ripped off, Jesse steps in, but bites off more than he can chew; Skyler takes the opportunity to show her appreciation for Gretchen's kindness in picking up the tab for Walt's treatments.
breaking-bad.2-7: Walt and Jesse contemplate an expansion of their business; Hank experiences a hassle in El Paso as he tries to adapt to his new coworkers; Skyler's new job opportunity leads to her reconnecting with an ex-colleague; and Jesse interacts with his new landlady.
breaking-bad.2-8: Badger's brush with the law leads Walt and Jesse to call in a shady lawyer; the DEA believes it has a line on the mysterious and elusive "Heisenberg"; Hank's stint in El Paso is up and he returns to Albuquerque, but his mental makeup causes concern for Marie.
breaking-bad.2-9: After undergoing a PET-CAT scan and fearing the worst, Walt takes lawyer Saul's advice and hunkers down for a marathon session of cooking product; Jesse's romance with his landlady is heating up, but must cool off quickly when he and Walt head for the desert to take care of business.
breaking-bad.2-10: The Whites throw a party to thank family and friends for their support through Walt's trying time, but it turns ugly when he and Hank get into a bitter argument; later, a pent-up and fed-up Walt tries to occupy his time with home-improvement projects. Worried about Walt's physical and emotional states, Skyler confides in her boss; Jane keeps her relationship with Jesse a secret from her father.
breaking-bad.2-11: Saul suggests a new business partner for Walt and Jesse after they begin to lose their dealers to some unforeseen circumstances. At work, Skyler confronts Ted after she uncovers some unnerving information; and Jesse opens up to Jane about what he does for a living, with disastrous results.
breaking-bad.2-12: A new addition joins the White family as Walter Jr. attempts to help out his struggling family by launching a new Web site. Elsewhere, Jesse's addiction worsens and his relationship with Jane begins to negatively impact Walt and her father.
breaking-bad.2-13: In the Season 2 finale, Skyler's frustration with Walt's secrecy boils over; Jesse is dealt a devastating blow that leads him down a path of self-destruction, and only Walt is willing to help him; and a grief-stricken Donald experiences more tragedy.
breaking-bad.3-1: In the third-season premiere, Walt faces a new threat on a new front and deals with an increasingly angry Skyler, who must consider what to do next with her life and the kids'. Meanwhile, Jesse comes face-to-face with some startling self-revelations.
breaking-bad.3-2: Despite ever-increasing tension between Walt and Skyler, he pulls out all the stops in an effort to reconcile with the family. Elsewhere, Saul is instrumental in getting Jesse involved in a most-unusual investment opportunity.
breaking-bad.3-3: Walt disregards Skyler's demands and the rift between them widens dramatically, pushing her to take even more drastic steps. Meanwhile, continuing anxiety and panic attacks plague Hank, which leads to a serious situation at the Drug Enforcement Agency.
breaking-bad.3-4: Skyler's latest bit of bad news proves to be a blow to Walt, and his loss of control endangers his job and his business relationships with Saul and Jesse. Hank goes full-speed ahead into the agency's investigation of the blue-meth case, while Jesse cooks up a new plan.
breaking-bad.3-5: When Gus intensifies efforts to persuade Walt to get back in the meth business, Jesse takes exception and a rift appears in his and Walt's personal relationship. Meanwhile, Skyler's new relationship isn't turning out as she'd like; and Marie tells Skyler about her concerns for the increasingly troubled Hank and his well-being.
breaking-bad.3-6: Walt moves into new digs and a distraught Walter Jr. demands to know just where his parents' relationship stands. Meanwhile, Hank's investigation is beginning to hit too close to home for Walt, causing serious concerns for him and Jesse.
breaking-bad.3-7: Hank's behavior becomes increasingly more unpredictable and volatile, which leads to a confrontation with Jesse and problems at the DEA; Skyler wants Walt to make a deal; and Gus' decisions result in some serious consequences.
breaking-bad.3-8: The White and Schrader families anxiously await word on Hank's condition. Meanwhile, Jesse takes care of business at the lab while Walt tries to make peace with Gus, but after witnessing a terrifying flash of anger, Walt starts to fear for his and his family's lives.
breaking-bad.3-9: Hank's stay in the hospital is accompanied by some daunting bills, but Skyler thinks she has a way of dealing with them. Meanwhile, some of the problems between Walt and Gus are ameliorated; and Jesse seeks more independence and grabs a profitable opportunity that presents itself.
breaking-bad.3-10: When Walt becomes driven to distraction by a contaminant in the lab, he refuses to cook meth until they are able to get rid of it.
breaking-bad.3-11: Skyler's increased involvement in Walt's business causes him concern; Hank's recovery is plagued by setbacks; and Jesse makes a surprising discovery as he gets more involved in his new enterprise.
breaking-bad.3-12: Jesse ignores Walt's advice and finds himself in a dangerous situation. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic measures to try to put things right. And tragedy strikes following an unexpected confrontation.
breaking-bad.3-13: Jesse goes on the lam in the third-season finale. But Mike is right on his heels, so Walt works a deal with Gus and comes up with an unsettling plan that might help guarantee both his and Jesse's safety.
breaking-bad.4-1: In the Season 4 opener, Walt and Jesse are confronted by the life-threatening consequences of their actions. Meanwhile, Skyler contends with a puzzling disappearance, and Marie finds it difficult to help a recovering Hank.
breaking-bad.4-2: Walt tries to establish a new alliance as he plots his next move. Meanwhile, Skyler urges Walt to consider a business opportunity that could keep the family safe.
breaking-bad.4-3: Goings-on at Jesse's place start to get out of control; Skyler reluctantly turns to Saul for help; Marie settles back into an old habit; and Hank hears from an old friend who needs assistance.
breaking-bad.4-4: The Cartel makes a power move; Skyler and Walt reveal something embarrassing to the family; and Jesse's misdeeds bring some unwanted attention.
breaking-bad.4-5: Jesse's disappearance leaves Walt fearing the worst; Skyler has a surprising reunion; and Hank gives Det. Roberts bad news.
breaking-bad.4-6: A shocking discovery unsettles Skyler; Walter Jr. leans on his father to make a special purchase; Mike gets surprise help from Jesse.
breaking-bad.4-7: A frustrated Walt takes on a risky gamble; Skyler encounters problems with her latest business venture; Hank requires Walter Jr.'s services for an unusual reason.
breaking-bad.4-8: Skyler devises a plan to cure her money woes; Hank recruits Walt to help him work out a theory, while Walt grows impatient with Jesse.
breaking-bad.4-9: Mistakes from Skyler's past prove to be impactful to the present; Gus is spurred to action against rivals; Jesse seeks help from Walt but the results are mixed.
breaking-bad.4-10: The family becomes gravely concerned when Walt doesn't show up for his son's 16th birthday celebration. And Jesse's lab skills are tested in Walt's absence.
breaking-bad.4-11: Walt moves to protect his secret and Gus; Skyler is stymied in her attempt to help Ted with his financial problem.
breaking-bad.4-12: Hank leans on Gomez to explore one final lead, as Walt scrambles to protect his family. Meanwhile, Jesse learns some unsettling news and races to share it with Walt.
breaking-bad.4-13: The fourth season ends with Walt and Jesse squaring off against Gus. Elsewhere, Walt acquires a surprise confederate with help from Saul.
breaking-bad.5-1: In the series 5 premiere, Walt deals with the aftermath of the explosion, while Hank wraps up his investigation of Gus and his criminal empire.
breaking-bad.5-2: Walt and Jesse seek out an unlikely partner for a new business venture. The DEA follows up new leads in its investigation.
breaking-bad.5-3: Walt and Jesse put a business plan into action. Walt confesses a secret to Marie.
breaking-bad.5-4: Walt celebrates another birthday. Skyler considers her options. An associate complicates Walt and Jesse's plan.
breaking-bad.5-5: Walt's team must get creative to obtain the materials they need to continue their operation.
breaking-bad.5-6: Walt, Jesse, and Mike struggle over the future of their business, as occupational hazards weigh on Jesse.
breaking-bad.5-7: Walt takes control of business matters as Mike grapples with the consequences of his actions.
breaking-bad.5-8: Walt ties up loose ends. Seeing the evidence of his success, he makes a startling and dangerous decision.
breaking-bad.5-9: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.
breaking-bad.5-10: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.
breaking-bad.5-11: Jesse decides to make a change, while Walt and Skyler try to deal with an unexpected demand.
breaking-bad.5-12: An unusual strategy starts to bear fruit, while plans are set in motion that could change everything.
breaking-bad.5-13: Things heat up for Walt in unexpected ways.
breaking-bad.5-14: Everyone copes with radically changed circumstances.
breaking-bad.5-15: Events set in motion long ago move toward a conclusion.
breaking-bad.5-16: The acclaimed crime drama comes to a close in the series finale.
breaking-bad.0-1: Fugitive Jesse Pinkman attempts to outrun his past.

severance.1-2: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

the-bear.1-2: A surprise health inspection reveals the cracks in the restaurant's foundation. Carmy goes head-to-head with Richie.
the-bear.1-3: Carmy attends Al-Anon. Sydney struggles to gain the respect of the staff.
the-bear.1-4: Carmy and Richie cater a kid's birthday party. Tina and Sydney work together while Marcus makes donuts.

ted-lasso.1-1: American football coach Ted Lasso is hired by a wealthy divorcée to coach the English soccer team AFC Richmond.
ted-lasso.1-2: It's Ted's first day of coaching, and fans aren't happy. He makes little headway but remains undeterred as the team plays its first match.
ted-lasso.1-3: To arrange an in-depth exposé, Rebecca pairs cynical journalist Trent Crimm with Ted for a day. Ted and Roy venture into the community.
ted-lasso.1-4: Rebecca hosts the team's annual charity benefit, where Ted stages a reconciliation between Roy and Jamie.
ted-lasso.1-5: With his wife and son visiting from America, Ted makes drastic changes to the lineup during a critical match.
ted-lasso.1-6: When Jamie refuses to train, Ted turns to talented new signing Dani Rojas and the team is struck by an age-old curse.
ted-lasso.1-7: Rebecca celebrates her first anniversary as a divorcée as the team plays a match in Liverpool.
ted-lasso.1-8: Ted and Roy are both having relationship problems. Ted consults the Diamond Dogs while Roy lays it on the line with Keeley.
ted-lasso.1-9: After a series of mistakes on the pitch, pressure mounts to bench Roy. Rebecca finally reveals the truth to Ted.
ted-lasso.1-10: Richmond plays a climactic match that will determine the fates of Ted and his club.
ted-lasso.2-1: AFC Richmond brings in a sports psychologist to help the team overcome their unprecedented seven game tie-streak.
ted-lasso.2-2: Ted is surprised by the reappearance of a familiar face. Roy tries out a new gig.
ted-lasso.2-3: Rebecca has a special visitor shadow her at work. A player's return is not welcomed by the team.
ted-lasso.2-4: It's Christmas in Richmond. Rebecca enlists Ted for a secret mission, Roy and Keeley search for a miracle, and the Higginses open up their home.
ted-lasso.2-5: Nate learns how to be assertive from Keeley and Rebecca. Ted asks Roy for a favor.
ted-lasso.2-6: Ted is fired up that the new team dynamic seems to be working. But will they have a chance in the semifinal?
ted-lasso.2-7: With things turning around for Richmond, it's time for everyone to work on their issues—like Ted's discomfort, Nate's confidence, and Roy's attention.
ted-lasso.2-8: Ted and Dr. Sharon realize they might have to meet each other halfway. Tensions are high as the team prepares for the semifinal.
ted-lasso.2-9: After the semifinal, Beard sets out on an all-night odyssey through London in an effort to collect his thoughts.
ted-lasso.2-10: Rebecca is stunned by a sudden loss. The team rallies to show their support, but Ted finds himself grappling with a piece of his past.
ted-lasso.2-11: A billionaire football enthusiast from Ghana makes Sam an unbelievable offer. Ted plans something special for Dr. Sharon's last day with the team.
ted-lasso.2-12: Richmond gets their final chance to win promotion as Ted deals with the fallout of Trent Crimm's painfully honest exposé.
ted-lasso.3-1: The newly promoted AFC Richmond face mockery as pundits predict they'll finish dead last this season.
ted-lasso.3-2: News of a top player looking to move to London sends the English clubs into a frenzy. Richmond play their first game back in the Premier League.
ted-lasso.3-3: Richmond adjust to an exciting change, but Jamie has reservations. Ted learns there's something new going on back in Kansas as well.
ted-lasso.3-4: Everyone's feeling the pressure as Richmond gear up to play West Ham. Ted is reunited with an old friend.
ted-lasso.3-5: With their season in a tailspin, Richmond try to right the ship against mighty Manchester City. Off the pitch, everyone faces their own setbacks.
ted-lasso.3-6: A friendly match takes the team to Amsterdam, where one night out unlocks truths for many.
ted-lasso.3-7: The Greyhounds try a new strategy that has everyone thinking outside the box. Sam prepares to host a VIP guest at Ola's.
ted-lasso.3-8: While watching Henry, Ted fights the urge to spiral when Michelle and Dr. Jacob go on a romantic trip. An online leak has massive implications for Keeley.
ted-lasso.3-9: Colin and Isaac's friendship is tested. Roy is asked to do a press conference.
ted-lasso.3-10: While some of the Greyhounds head home to play for their countries in international matches, Edwin Akufo brings a business proposal to Rebecca.
ted-lasso.3-11: An unexpected guest has Ted on edge. When Richmond travel to Manchester for a big match, Roy and Keeley become concerned about Jamie.
ted-lasso.3-12: Season finale. AFC Richmond play their final match of the season.
ted-lasso.4-1: A few years after Ted leaves Richmond, some familiar faces visit him in Kansas…or is it Missouri?
ted-lasso.4-2: Ted returns to Richmond to meet the Lady Greyhounds, but not everyone is glad to see him.
ted-lasso.4-3: Richmond's shareholders are unsure about a women's team. The coaches hold tryouts to fill out their roster.
ted-lasso.4-4: The coaches must figure out how to break up team cliques. Ted adjusts to life outside the locker room.
ted-lasso.4-5: The ladies face off against Chelsea. Alice feels the pressure. Rebecca navigates a complicated dynamic.
ted-lasso.4-6: It's New Year's Eve! The team celebrates big. Rebecca, Roy, and Keeley ring it in with an old friend.
ted-lasso.4-7: Alice and Ted try stepping outside their comfort zones. Zelda helps with a new problem at Richmond.
ted-lasso.4-8: The Lady Greyhounds navigate a difficult setback. Roy and Keeley prepare for the Wall of Legends.
ted-lasso.4-9: Morale is low, but the stakes have never been higher. Mae joins the team on the road. Keeley has news.
ted-lasso.4-10: Season finale. Big changes in bunches.

abbott-elementary.1-1: Passionate teachers -- and a slightly tone-deaf principal -- are determined to help their students succeed.
abbott-elementary.1-2: Janine takes it upon herself to fix every problem when she notices a flicking light bulb in the hallway; Gregory asks Barbara for help talking to a parent, which leads him to spend his lunch period in an unexpected way.
abbott-elementary.1-3: The teachers to ask the local community for new school supplies; Janine encourages Gregory to decorate his classroom.
abbott-elementary.1-4: When a new computer program is introduced at Abbott, Janine is excited to finally help Barbara with something; Barbara is reluctant to accept change and finds herself in a tricky situation; Melissa surprises Jacob.
abbott-elementary.1-5: After a negative teacher review, Janine gets a confidence boost when a student gets transferred from Melissa's class into hers; Jacob tries to forge a friendship with an uninterested Gregory.
abbott-elementary.1-6: Janine convinces Ava to start a gifted program at Abbott led by Jacob; Barbara pushes a hesitant Melissa to start dating again.
abbott-elementary.1-7: Janine is thrilled when her best friend from college is hired as the art teacher; Jacob and Barbara decide to start a school garden.
abbott-elementary.1-8: After Jacob reveals a detail about his personal life, Janine realizes she doesn't know the other teachers as well as she thought; Gregory's stern teaching approach is causing his whole class to underperform.
abbott-elementary.1-9: Ava asks Janine to help her teach the after-school step class, but they don't agree on how to run the program; Gregory must reveal a secret when Barbara, Melissa and Jacob plan a pizza "eat-off."
abbott-elementary.1-10: Janine prepares to meet her struggling student's mother during open house, while the rest of the faculty uses the time to relax; Gregory is taken aback when he learns how Ava got the principal job; Barbara's daughter's visit creates a commotion.
abbott-elementary.1-11: When the students start participating in a new online trend that causes disruption to the school, the teachers band together to put an end to it; Mr. Johnson provides comforting life advice to Gregory; the teachers finally meet Jacob's boyfriend.
abbott-elementary.1-12: With the school board threatening to pull their funds, Janine and Gregory decide to help Ava out with her presentation; their plan is derailed when a curveball is thrown at Ava; Barbara offends Melissa when she doesn't agree with her blackmail idea.
abbott-elementary.1-13: While on Abbott's annual zoo field trip, Tariq reveals that he has been offered a job in New York; Janine struggles with a big choice; Barbara starts questioning her future after finding out her favorite tuatara has been retired because of old age.
abbott-elementary.2-1: The teachers are back for development week, a time to prepare for the upcoming year; Janine is determined to start the year off right and leave her problems at home; Ava runs a side hustle out of the school parking lot.
abbott-elementary.2-2: Janine is determined to make Abbott Elementary look just as good as a new charter school; Gregory goes out of his way to avoid Barbara; Ava hosts an event to help decide what to do with the rest of the funds from the grant.
abbott-elementary.2-3: A traveling storytelling troupe Jacob used to be in visits Abbott Elementary for a day of education and entertainment; Melissa struggles with the new normal of her combined second and third grade class.
abbott-elementary.2-4: After Gregory sends a disruptive student to the principal's office, he discovers the kids actually enjoy spending supposed disciplinary time with Ava; Melissa invites Janine over to her house to teach her how to cook.
abbott-elementary.2-5: Janine is thrilled to help introduce a new beverage to the cafeteria, but it ends up causing unexpected consequences; Melissa clashes with her new aide, Ashley, who brings more disruption than help to the classroom.
abbott-elementary.2-6: A student steals a bag of Halloween candy meant to be given out to the kids at the end of the day and starts distributing it during school hours; Janine is invited to a Halloween party by an old friend and starts to reconsider her personal life.
abbott-elementary.2-7: The teachers are appalled after seeing a commercial in support of charter schools criticizing Abbott Elementary; Janine and Gregory talk about Janine's relationship with Tariq.
abbott-elementary.2-8: When the eighth grade science class participates in an egg drop activity, Janine insists her second grade class join in; Barbara is shocked at the clothing one of her student's parents wears.
abbott-elementary.2-9: Janine is out sick for the day, so Ava grows desperate and must step in to help out; Barbara and Melissa revel in the quieter-than-normal teacher's lounge.
abbott-elementary.2-10: Janine is convinced by a friend to go to a popular hookah club where she runs into unexpected colleagues; Jacob crashes Barbara and Melissa's traditional holiday dinner and in the process begins to learn the true meaning of Christmas.
abbott-elementary.2-11: The competition heats up between Melissa and Janine as their classes go head-to-head in a read-a-thon sponsored by a local pizza shop; Jacob and Gregory join forces and attempt to get their student-podcasting club off the ground.
abbott-elementary.2-12: Two of Janine's students aren't getting along, leading her to seek advice from her colleagues on how to help repair their friendship; Melissa and Ava plot to bring down Mr. Johnson in fantasy football.
abbott-elementary.2-13: Barbara organizes a candy-selling fundraiser to raise money for a school field trip to the science museum; when sales don't go as planned, Ava steps in to teach the students new, unconventional selling tactics.
abbott-elementary.2-14: The Abbott teachers discuss their relationships and plans for Valentine's Day; Janine finds out one of her students has a crush on her; Ava sits in on Jacob's Black History class after receiving a complaint.
abbott-elementary.2-15: Barbara's candle accidentally starts a small fire in the teacher's lounge, and a counselor suggests that she might not be handling the aftermath well; Melissa rekindles her childhood dream of being a firefighter.
abbott-elementary.2-16: Staff members head to the Pennsylvania Educational Conference; Gregory reluctantly attends after a disagreement with Amber; Jacob finds himself charmed by the Addington teachers.
abbott-elementary.2-17: Jacob secures a visit from a mural arts program for his students; Barbara and Melissa learn parents are petitioning to turn Abbott into a charter school.
abbott-elementary.2-18: On Teacher Appreciation Day, the district gives Abbott two courtside tickets to a 76ers game and the teachers must decide who deserves them; Janine invites the teachers to her house for game night and her sister, Ayesha, comes to visit.
abbott-elementary.2-19: Abbott Elementary rallies together to fight the threat from Legendary Charter Schools; Ava pitches a festival to draw parents to school and collect their signatures for a petition, but Draemond shows up with the intention of derailing the event.
abbott-elementary.2-20: Gregory is named Educator of the Year; Janine deals with a difficult student; it is revealed that Barbara hasn't completed her teaching requirements.
abbott-elementary.2-21: Janine's plan for a Memorial Day weekend solo trip is derailed when her mother shows up unannounced asking for help; Gregory notices his colleagues are great at small talk and realizes he needs to brush up on his people skills.
abbott-elementary.2-22: Abbott Elementary takes a field trip to the Franklin Institute; Gregory is eager to spend time with a reluctant Janine; Ava teaches the students about aliens, which leads to chaos.
abbott-elementary.3-1: Janine plans a district-wide initiative -- Career Day -- and is anxious for it to be a success; Ava has a new approach to her job; Melissa is asked a surprising question.
abbott-elementary.3-2: Janine plans a district-wide initiative -- Career Day -- and is anxious for it to be a success; Ava has a new approach to her job; Melissa is asked a surprising question.
abbott-elementary.3-3: Gregory is hesitant when kids start hanging out in his classroom at lunch, looking to him for advice; Barbara is shocked to find Tariq is dating the mother of one of her students; Janine and Jacob try to hire an ASL interpreter.
abbott-elementary.3-4: After a student is caught smoking, the staff come together to revamp the outdated drug policy; Janine tries to prep the new substitute teacher for her class, but finds it challenging to give up her former role.
abbott-elementary.3-5: When Barbara's church choir uses the gym for rehearsals, Ava notices tension in the group; Jacob's eagerness for a full social calendar worries Gregory; Melissa and Janine investigate a new substitute.
abbott-elementary.3-6: Abbott Elementary is deemed a Philadelphia historical landmark, much to Ava and Janine's delight; the school plans a celebration in honor of its namesake, but not everything goes as planned.
abbott-elementary.3-7: Janine spearheads a pilot program that brings a librarian to Abbott; Melissa and Jacob deal with some big changes at home.
abbott-elementary.3-8: Ava and Gregory are invited to speak on a panel about public schools, while the other teachers must complete CPR training; Janine faces challenges securing district approval for her librarian extension program.
abbott-elementary.3-9: Jacob is shocked when he finds out his colleagues are not invested in his frequent email messages and haven't even been writing their own replies; Gregory turns to Janine for help with a former student.
abbott-elementary.3-10: Ava Fest is back, and with the help of the teachers, Ava's set on outdoing last year by any means necessary; after Janine accepts the offer for a full-time position at the district, she just has to check off one last thing to make it official.
abbott-elementary.3-11: Two teachers head out on a double date, but when they run into familiar bar patrons, it proves to be an unfortunate distraction; at Ava's first book club meeting, the group ends up in a debate over who would be the best post-apocalyptic leader.
abbott-elementary.3-12: Barbara invites Gregory to her family's Mother's Day brunch; Jacob scrambles to figure out how to organize a school field trip.
abbott-elementary.3-13: Jacob manages to pull off a school-wide field trip to the park, but when Abbott must share the playground, the fun and games turn competitive; Mr. Johnson enjoys having an empty school to himself.
abbott-elementary.3-14: Ahead of summer vacation, Janine throws the perfect end-of-year party for her colleagues and friends, taking all their interests into consideration.
abbott-elementary.4-1: The neighboring construction site of a new golf course causes issues at Abbott, forcing the teachers to find creative solutions; an HR representative visits the school; following their kiss, Janine and Gregory's relationship status is revealed.
abbott-elementary.4-2: When it's revealed that a student in Jacob's class has ringworm, the faculty must band together to stop it from spreading through the entire school.
abbott-elementary.4-3: Janine gets a budget for class pets, but Melissa is resistant to taking on the added work and responsibility for her room's guinea pig; an IT rep from the school district arrives to set up new computers.
abbott-elementary.4-4: It's Halloween at Abbott Elementary and Janine and Gregory proudly show off their couple's costume, but it fails to translate; Barbara faces pushback from parents concerned about hygiene and her beloved apple-bobbing tradition.
abbott-elementary.4-5: Gregory forms a bond with one of his students, but the student's dad becomes jealous of their relationship and seeks a confrontation; Melissa suffers a fall but avoids receiving medical attention for the injury.
abbott-elementary.4-6: When the neighborhood deli is forced to close to make room for a trendy smoothie place, Melissa, Barbara and Jacob team up to fight the gentrification; the district asks Ava to give a presentation to fellow principals.
abbott-elementary.4-7: Despite a few setbacks, Barbara is determined to make Abbott Elementary's first-ever holiday show a success; Jacob's brother arrives for his visit earlier than planned.
abbott-elementary.4-8: Melissa hosts the Schemmenti family Christmas Eve dinner and goes to great lengths to make sure everything is perfect; Janine and Gregory get an unexpected guest.
abbott-elementary.4-9: Ava announces the school district is sending a group of volunteers to help out at Abbott; however, when they arrive, things don't go as planned.
abbott-elementary.4-10: Janine must rethink her lesson plans after her class performs poorly on a practice test; Jacob struggles to engage a disinterested student; the district sends a new custodian to train under Mr. Johnson.
abbott-elementary.4-11: When city buses stop running due to a strike, resulting in many students being absent from school, the teachers at Abbott try to find creative solutions and adapt to hybrid learning; Gregory and O'Shon strike up a friendship.
abbott-elementary.4-12: The Abbott Elementary students and staff are invited to a special grand opening preview of the Girard Creek Golf Club.
abbott-elementary.4-13: While supervising the kids making their science fair projects, the teachers' competitive sides come out.
abbott-elementary.4-14: Ava and the Abbott teachers plan for the annual school district budget meeting; Janine and Gregory prepare for Valentine's Day as a couple.
abbott-elementary.4-15: During Abbott's 100th day of school celebrations, Barbara receives a surprise from her daughter; Jacob and Mr. Johnson join forces to conduct a search party.
abbott-elementary.4-16: A debate over a controversial book leads Ava to remove it from the library, but some parents push for its return.
abbott-elementary.4-17: When the teachers hit a karaoke bar for a night of fun, Jacob bumps into an old friend.
abbott-elementary.4-18: Ava and the teachers must band together to hide the golf-course contraband.
abbott-elementary.4-19: Barbara and Gregory are in over their heads when they find themselves in new roles at Abbott Elementary.
abbott-elementary.4-20: The Abbott teachers turn their open house into a car wash to help raise money for the school.
abbott-elementary.4-21: Ava and the Abbott teachers go to the district to plead for Ava's job back; Gregory handles duties as interim principal.
abbott-elementary.4-22: Abbott Elementary goes on a schoolwide field trip to the Please Touch Museum, which has some of the older kids skeptical.
abbott-elementary.5-1: The teachers prepare for the upcoming school year with new faces and big changes on the horizon.
abbott-elementary.5-2: Melissa tries to outsmart her students; Tariq causes chaos in Janine's class; a new guidance counselor joins the school.
abbott-elementary.5-3: The Abbott crew heads to the ballpark for Teachers' Appreciation Night at the Philadelphia Phillies game.
abbott-elementary.5-4: Gregory steps in to host game night at his apartment; Mr. Johnson, Ava, Barbara and Melissa head to the DMV to renew their licenses.
abbott-elementary.5-5: Barbara organizes a Halloween camping trip for older kids.
abbott-elementary.5-6: Abbott Elementary participates in the district's No Phones Day initiative.
abbott-elementary.5-7: A new member joins Gregory's Garden Goofballs; Janine pitches a new club idea to Ava.
abbott-elementary.5-8: Jacob takes the lead on organizing Abbott's annual winter show; Janine celebrates her 30th birthday.
abbott-elementary.5-9: Abbott Elementary returns from winter break at their new temporary school: an abandoned mall; the teachers deal with unique challenges that come with teaching in the new location.
abbott-elementary.5-10: Growing pains hit Abbott Elementary as the PTA pressures Janine and Gregory for answers; Jacob and Barbara become suspicious of Mr. Morton.
abbott-elementary.5-11: After the faculty finds surprising success operating the school in the mall, they quickly realize they are being taken advantage of. Meanwhile, a new custodian arrives to join Mr. Johnson.
abbott-elementary.5-12: When picture day catches the teachers at Abbott by surprise, chaos ensues.
abbott-elementary.5-13: It's Valentine's Day at Abbott, and the teachers find themselves meddling in students' love lives while navigating their own.
abbott-elementary.5-14: Janine asks Ava for a classroom aide; the school seeks out a new gym teacher; Dominic confides in Jacob.
abbott-elementary.5-15: An antidrug campaign visits the school, and Jacob is outraged by an unfair district election.
abbott-elementary.5-16: Jacob and Ava team up for an initiative. Meanwhile, Melissa and Janine help Mr. Johnson get ready for the Janitor's Ball.
abbott-elementary.5-17: Ava implements a no-homework policy at Abbott, sparking debate amongst the teachers.
abbott-elementary.5-18: It's April Fools' Day, and while the Abbott teachers suffer pranks, Gregory makes a plan to make it through the day.
abbott-elementary.5-19: Janine and Gregory plan a vacation. Meanwhile, one of Melissa's most successful former students comes back for a visit.
abbott-elementary.5-20: Janine and Gregory have a night out. Meanwhile, Melissa, Barbara and Mr. Johnson have a movie night.
abbott-elementary.5-21: It's Ava Fest, and Ava's determined to make it her biggest yet.
abbott-elementary.5-22: Rumors begin to swirl when the Abbott crew is in Miami for PECSA weekend.
abbott-elementary.6-1: Gregory and Ava adjust to a new dynamic, while Barbara turns to Jacob for help. Meanwhile, Janine gives her classroom a makeover, and Melissa works to win hers back.
abbott-elementary.6-2: Gregory juggles the demands of his two roles, while Jacob and Melissa struggle to compromise. Meanwhile, Barbara manages a delicate situation with a student, and Janine checks in with Courtney.
abbott-elementary.6-3: The step team tries out for a major competition, Melissa and Barbara take a special ed certification course, while Janine, Gregory and Jacob welcome a new substitute.
abbott-elementary.6-4: Ava hosts an exclusive Halloween party, and Janine and Jacob get suspicious of Gregory.
abbott-elementary.6-5: Gregory and Melissa come together to address an issue with a teacher, while Janine spends time with Courtney.
abbott-elementary.6-6: Ava recruits Janine to prepare the step team for a competition, and Melissa calls in a favor for Gregory.
abbott-elementary.6-8: Jacob's parents visit for the holidays, while Barbara contends with some of her students falling behind.

the-last-of-us.1-1: Twenty years after a fungal outbreak ravages the planet, survivors Joel and Tess are tasked with a mission that could change everything.
the-last-of-us.1-2: After escaping the QZ, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate while navigating the ruins of a long-abandoned Boston.
the-last-of-us.1-3: When a stranger approaches his compound, survivalist Bill forges an unlikely connection. Later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance.
the-last-of-us.1-4: After abandoning their truck in Kansas City, Joel and Ellie attempt to escape without drawing the attention of a vindictive rebel leader.
the-last-of-us.1-5: While attempting to evade the rebels, Joel and Ellie cross paths with the most wanted man in Kansas City. Kathleen continues her hunt.
the-last-of-us.1-6: After ignoring the advice of locals, Joel and Ellie descend deeper into dangerous territory in search of the Fireflies – and Tommy.
the-last-of-us.1-7: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie looks back on the night that changed everything.
the-last-of-us.1-8: Ellie crosses paths with a vengeful group of survivors – and draws the attention of its leader. A weakened Joel faces a new threat.
the-last-of-us.1-9: A pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Later, Joel and Ellie near the end of their journey.
the-last-of-us.0-1: Go behind the scenes with the cast and crew of The Last of Us to see how they brought the show to life in a special behind the scenes featurette.
the-last-of-us.2-1: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.
the-last-of-us.2-2: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.
the-last-of-us.2-3: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.
the-last-of-us.2-4: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.
the-last-of-us.2-5: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.
the-last-of-us.2-6: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. As their rift continues to widen, Ellie prepares for a confrontation, while Joel makes a difficult choice out on patrol.
the-last-of-us.2-7: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

the-white-lotus.1-1: As the White Lotus welcomes their newest guests, tensions quickly arise between the hotel staff and the volatile vacationers.
the-white-lotus.1-2: Belinda walks a fine line with Tanya. Armond deals with his guilt. Rachel seeks advice from Nicole. Mark reconnects with family.
the-white-lotus.1-3: Mark processes revelations about his dad. Armond has a surprise in store for Shane. Tanya leans on Belinda for support. Paula has a secret.
the-white-lotus.1-4: Rachel floats a career change to Shane. Belinda starts to take Tanya's proposition seriously. Armond's renewed sobriety is put to the test.
the-white-lotus.1-5: Feeling sidelined, Rachel begins to rethink her marriage. Armond attempts damage control. Paula becomes disillusioned with the Mossbachers.
the-white-lotus.1-6: Rachel reveals stark truths. The Mossbachers turn the page on a traumatic event. Belinda gets bad news, and Armond exacts revenge.
the-white-lotus.2-1: Two couples navigate awkwardness, an Italian American family deals with a conspicuous absence, and Tanya arrives with her new assistant.
the-white-lotus.2-2: Tanya enlists Greg to help her live out her perfect Sicilian day. Harper questions Cameron and Daphne's claims about their marriage.
the-white-lotus.2-3: While Daphne loops Harper into an off-resort excursion, Ethan and Cameron get in some bro time. Tanya seeks advice from a tarot reader.
the-white-lotus.2-4: Tanya and Portia spend a day with charming ex-pats Quentin and Jack. Harper is blindsided by shocking evidence from Ethan's night out.
the-white-lotus.2-5: Tanya and Portia embark on a whirlwind excursion with Quentin and Jack. Unsure what to believe, Harper gets real with Cam and Daphne.
the-white-lotus.2-6: Ethan grows suspicious of Cam. Tanya gives Portia an opaque warning about Jack. Lucia helps the Di Grassos search for long-lost relatives.
the-white-lotus.2-7: Albie asks Dominic for a karmic payment to help Lucia. Tanya grows wary of Quentin's motives. Ethan confronts Cam.
the-white-lotus.3-1: As a new round of guests arrives at the White Lotus Thailand, Belinda settles in, Chelsea deals with a moody Rick, the Ratliffs go separate ways, and Kate, Laurie, and Jaclyn kick off a girls' trip.
the-white-lotus.3-2: Timothy gets distressing updates about his business, Chelsea connects with expat Chloe, and Gaitok shares his feelings with Mook.
the-white-lotus.3-3: Jaclyn pushes the idea of a vacation fling on Laurie. Chelsea finds herself in a perilous situation. Gaitok worries about a reprimand.
the-white-lotus.3-4: Jaclyn looks for a different scene. Piper asks for Lochlan's support before sharing a life update. Chelsea finally gets Rick to open up.
the-white-lotus.3-5: As things get wild during the Full Moon festivities, Rick visits an old friend, and Belinda shares her suspicions about a hotel guest.
the-white-lotus.3-6: In the wake of the festivities, Laurie finds herself feeling deceived by Jaclyn, while Saxon tries to bury what happened the night before.
the-white-lotus.3-7: Belinda brings Zion to Chloe's expat party. Saxon confronts Tim about how strange he's been acting. Gaitok and Mook have their first date.
the-white-lotus.3-8: Laurie, Jaclyn, and Kate reckon with their friendship. Timothy comes up with a shocking plan for his family. Belinda considers a deal.

stranger-things.1-1: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.
stranger-things.1-2: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.
stranger-things.1-3: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.
stranger-things.1-4: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.
stranger-things.1-5: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.
stranger-things.1-6: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.
stranger-things.1-7: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.
stranger-things.1-8: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.
stranger-things.2-1: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.
stranger-things.2-2: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.
stranger-things.2-3: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.
stranger-things.2-4: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.
stranger-things.2-5: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. "Bob the Brain" tackles a difficult problem.
stranger-things.2-6: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.
stranger-things.2-7: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.
stranger-things.2-8: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.
stranger-things.2-9: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.
stranger-things.3-1: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.
stranger-things.3-2: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.
stranger-things.3-3: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.
stranger-things.3-4: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.
stranger-things.3-5: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.
stranger-things.3-6: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.
stranger-things.3-7: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.
stranger-things.3-8: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.
stranger-things.4-1: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.
stranger-things.4-2: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.
stranger-things.4-3: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.
stranger-things.4-4: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.
stranger-things.4-5: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.
stranger-things.4-6: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.
stranger-things.4-7: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.
stranger-things.4-8: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.
stranger-things.4-9: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.
stranger-things.5-1: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.
stranger-things.5-2: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.
stranger-things.5-3: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.
stranger-things.5-4: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.
stranger-things.5-5: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.
stranger-things.5-6: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.
stranger-things.5-7: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.
stranger-things.5-8: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

succession.3-1: Following his bombshell presser, a righteous Kendall scrambles to find a base of operations, while Logan's team searches for safe harbor.
succession.3-2: Kendall tries to get his siblings, as well as Stewy and Sandi, on his side. Fearing his legal situation, Greg asks Ewan for help.
succession.3-3: With the DOJ at the door, Logan summons his arsenal, while Tom makes a potentially life changing offer. Kendall becomes obsessed with his own takedown.
succession.3-4: Logan and Kendall have their first meeting together with Josh, a major investor worried about their family feud.
succession.3-5: Kendall and the Waystar team find themselves working together at the annual shareholders' meeting, where Logan's health takes a turn.
succession.3-6: Logan and the team heads to Virginia for a conservative political conference, where Roman learns some surprising news.
succession.3-7: At Kendall's lavish birthday bash, Shiv and Roman try to arrange a meeting with Lukas Matsson, a tech mogul who recently snubbed Logan.
succession.3-8: At a luxe family wedding in Italy, Roman airs suspicions, Gerri draws a line, and the Waystar team grows concerned about rogue tweets.
succession.3-9: Matsson's vision for the GoJo-Waystar relationship leads Shiv and Roman to manage the fallout, while Logan weighs his options.

friends.1-1: Monica's old friend Rachel moves in with her after leaving her fiancé.
friends.1-2: Rachel returns her engagement ring; Ross's ex-wife has a revelation for him.
friends.1-3: Monica's friends find her new beau appealing; Phoebe finds a little something extra in her soda.
friends.1-4: Chandler and Joey take Ross to a hockey game -- with painful results; the ladies get someone else's pizza.
friends.1-5: Ross does laundry with Rachel; Joey uses Monica to get his old girlfriend back.
friends.1-6: Joey's new agent gets him a cheeky role in a movie; Chandler dates a woman with lots of baggage.
friends.1-7: A blackout traps Chandler in an ATM vestibule with model Jill Goodacre; a cat comes between Ross and Rachel.
friends.1-8: Monica and Ross mourn the loss of their grandmother.
friends.1-9: Monica tries to cook Thanksgiving dinner for the gang; Ross relishes the chance to talk to his unborn child.
friends.1-10: A new pet monkeys around with Ross's ego during the holidays; Phoebe falls for a scientist .
friends.1-11: Chandler's novelist mother visits -- and hits on Ross; Phoebe and Monica fall for the same guy.
friends.1-12: Phoebe has some bad news for Rachel about Paolo; Ross learns some of the results of his former wife's amniocentesis.
friends.1-13: Chandler sees Rachel naked; Joey learns his father is having an affair; Phoebe dates a psychiatrist.
friends.1-14: Chandler has a blind date with an ex-girlfriend -- whom he's broken up with twice before; the ladies light a "boyfriend bonfire"; Ross finds an unlikely Valentine's Day date.
friends.1-15: Chandler and Monica plan big career moves, while Ross labors to hit it off with a date.
friends.1-16: Ross attends Lamaze classes; Joey dates Phoebe's twin; and Chandler has the hots for a co-worker he's supposed to fire.
friends.1-17: Monica and Rachel meet two cute doctors; Ross looks to Jack for fatherly advice; Phoebe confronts her twin about Joey.
friends.1-18: The guys let the ladies in on a sacred ritual -- their poker game. Meanwhile, Rachel has an interview with Saks.
friends.1-19: Ross entrusts Rachel with his pet monkey for a day; Barry has a surprise for Rachel.
friends.1-20: Chandler's not a very smooth operator when it comes to calling a woman he went out with; Rachel gets involved with her ex-fiancé.
friends.1-21: Monica meets the woman who used her credit-card number; Ross realizes it's time to find a new home for Marcel.
friends.1-22: Phoebe gets temporary work as Chandler's secretary; Monica's new boyfriend is younger than she thinks.
friends.1-23: Ross quarrels with Susan in the delivery room as Carol prepares to give birth; Joey befriends a mother-to-be.
friends.1-24: Rachel finally realizes how much Ross likes her -- but not before he leaves for China on museum business.
friends.2-1: Rachel meets Ross's female travel companion; Joey unwittingly recommends a seamy tailor to Chandler; and Phoebe cuts Monica's hair.
friends.2-2: Monica goes shopping with Julie behind Rachel's back; Ross isn't exactly gaga over breast milk.
friends.2-3: The gang disturbs Mr. Heckles for the last time; Phoebe takes issue with Ross on the subject of evolution.
friends.2-4: Phoebe's secret husband shows up; Rachel tries to distract Ross from having sex with Julie.
friends.2-5: Chandler receives a sexy phone call meant for someone else; the gang becomes divided along income lines.
friends.2-6: An allergic reaction sends Ross to the hospital, leaving Chandler and Joey to look after Ben; Central Perk hires another singer to replace Phoebe.
friends.2-7: Rachel goes on a date in an effort to forget about Ross; Monica presses Chandler to complete an exercise program.
friends.2-8: Ross is torn between Rachel and Julie, so Chandler prompts him to list each woman's pros and cons; Monica concocts recipes for a new product.
friends.2-9: Phoebe confronts her grandmother about the father she never knew; things heat up at Monica's holiday party.
friends.2-10: Rachel dates a guy who's similar to Ross; Joey can get a part if he sleeps with the casting director; Fun Bobby is no fun without alcohol.
friends.2-11: Rachel's mother considers ending her marriage; Carol decides to marry her lover, Susan; Phoebe believes she's possessed.
friends.2-12: Ross searches for Marcel; Joey is attracted to an obsessed fan; Phoebe sings songs for kids.
friends.2-13: Ross learns Marcel is working on a movie, and the film's makeup artist seems to want Chandler; Monica and Rachel fight over Jean-Claude Van Damme, who appears as himself.
friends.2-14: Monica brings some things home from her parents' house, including a prom video; Rachel tells Ross that she doesn't think it will work out between them.
friends.2-15: Ross's work hinders the evolution of his and Rachel's romance; Monica has eyes for an older opthalmologist; Joey and Chandler enjoy a big-screen TV.
friends.2-16: Richard's relationship with a younger woman causes a stir at a party for Ross and Monica's dad; Joey decides to move out; Rachel gets a tattoo.
friends.2-17: Chandler gets a new roommate; Monica doesn't like having Ross around all the time; Phoebe makes a music video.
friends.2-18: The days in the life of Joey's character, Dr. Ramoray, are numbered; Chandler's new roommate scares him.
friends.2-19: Chandler wants Eddie to move out; Joey faces unemployment; a self-help book empowers the ladies.
friends.2-20: Rachel freaks when Ross talks about spending a lifetime together; Chandler and Joey befriend Richard; Phoebe is shocked by the ending of "Old Yeller."
friends.2-21: Bullies accost Ross and Chandler; Monica plays the stock market; and Phoebe attempts to meet her father again.
friends.2-22: When Rachel's divorcing parents both show up for her birthday, her friends hold two separate parties to keep them apart.
friends.2-23: A submariner surfaces to spend two weeks with Phoebe, who's come down with chicken pox; Joey plays the role of a data processor at Chandler's company.
friends.2-24: Rachel's in her ex-fiancé's wedding; Chandler has a cyberspace romance; Monica and Richard think about their future.
friends.3-1: Janice tries to change Joey's opinion of her; Ross's sexual fantasy isn't kept between him and Rachel; Monica can't shake memories of Richard.
friends.3-2: Nobody seems to be getting the message when Ross demands that the group get ready for his black-tie benefit.
friends.3-3: Monica turns her attention from making jam to maybe making a baby; Phoebe befriends a guy who's stalking her twin sister.
friends.3-4: Chandler decides to make a real commitment to Janice; Phoebe poses as Joey's agent; Ross is troubled by Ben's toy.
friends.3-5: The gang compiles "freebie lists"; Phoebe tries to get to know her half brother; Joey builds an entertainment center.
friends.3-6: The show flashes back to when the friends were acquaintances and pairing off was a possibility.
friends.3-7: Monica orders a bed from the store owned by Janice's estranged husband; Joey teaches soap-opera acting; Ross struggles through a dinner with Rachel's abrasive father.
friends.3-8: Joey reveals to Chandler that he saw Janice kissing her estranged husband; Rachel and Monica baby-sit Ben; Phoebe explains her fear of the dentist.
friends.3-9: Ross and Monica go nose-to-nose in an unfriendly Thanksgiving football game.
friends.3-10: Rachel quits Central Perk; Phoebe objects to the treatment of Christmas trees; Ross sells cookies for a "Brown Bird" scout he injured; Monica gets hooked on Mint Treasures.
friends.3-11: A drunken Chandler has a liaison with one of Joey's sisters; a nice guy recommends Rachel for a job.
friends.3-12: Ross is jealous of Mark; a romantic poet criticizes Monica in verse; Joey's a dancing fool for a Broadway musical audition.
friends.3-13: Monica sees Richard again and they agree to be just pals -- and occasional lovers; Phoebe's new beau has an embarrassing habit.
friends.3-14: Phoebe's ex-singing partner wants to reunite; Chandler likes a woman associated with a shameful incident from Joey's past; Ross wants to spend more time with Rachel.
friends.3-15: Ross and Rachel decide to take a break in their relationship; Phoebe dates a diplomat who requires a translator.
friends.3-16: Ross's fling with Chloe jeopardizes his future with Rachel, who learns of the misdeed after she says she wants to work things out.
friends.3-17: Rachel organizes a ski trip for all the friends except Ross, who must then come to their rescue when they run out of gas.
friends.3-18: Phoebe's upset by her brother's engagement to an older woman; Monica dates a computer-software mogul; Chandler tries to quit smoking.
friends.3-19: Mark asks out Rachel, who returns Ross's things; Monica still isn't attracted to millionaire Pete; Joey's irked by his costar in a play.
friends.3-20: Chandler's insincere "I'll call you" to Rachel's boss causes complications; Monica inherits a dollhouse; Joey and Kate get romantic.
friends.3-21: Ross helps an injured Rachel prepare for a business dinner, but doesn't tell her he's missing a chance to appear on TV; Pete buys Monica a restaurant; Chandler and Joey adopt a baby chick.
friends.3-22: The gang goes to the opening night of Joey's play and Rachel brings a date to make Ross jealous; Phoebe waits on hold so she can have her phone repaired before the warranty expires.
friends.3-23: Ross has an unusual growth; Phoebe is torn between two men she's dating; Monica thinks Pete is going to propose.
friends.3-24: Pete pursues the Ultimate Fighting championship; Chandler has a slap-happy new boss; Ross dates Phoebe's friend.
friends.3-25: Phoebe's quest to find her father leads the gang to a beach house -- and leads Phoebe to a fateful meeting with an old family friend; Rachel persuades Bonnie to make a change.
friends.4-1: At the beach house, Ross and Rachel appear on the threshold of a new era; Phoebe gets to know her birth mother; Monica is stung by a jellyfish.
friends.4-2: Phoebe thinks her mother's spirit resides in a cat; Monica dates a former high-school hunk; Joey tries to sell the entertainment center.
friends.4-3: Chandler's torrid fling with Rachel's boss puts him in a compromising position; Monica caters her mom's party.
friends.4-4: Joey' s roped into being the superintendent's practice dance partner; Phoebe gets fired.
friends.4-5: Chandler falls for Joey's new girlfriend; Phoebe likes the effect of a cold on her singing voice.
friends.4-6: Phoebe helps Monica cater a funeral; Chandler buys Kathy a special birthday gift; Ross's beautiful date has a very messy place.
friends.4-7: Chandler keeps Kathy company while Joey's out with another girl---and one thing leads to another.
friends.4-8: On Thanksgiving, Chandler begs for Joey's forgiveness about Kathy; Monica has eyes for Richard's son.
friends.4-9: Rachel is promised a promotion; a restaurateur confronts Monica after she writes a scathing review; Chandler and Ross prepare to party with a world-class carouser.
friends.4-10: Monica hires Joey so she can fire him to show who's the boss at the restaurant; Ross goes extra miles to date a gal from Poughkeepsie; Chandler plays matchmaker for Rachel.
friends.4-11: In lieu of a gift, newlyweds Frank Jr. and Alice ask Phoebe to be a surrogate mother for their child; Ross breaks an unwritten rule at the museum.
friends.4-12: Phoebe undergoes in-vitro fertilization; Monica and Rachel go up against Joey and Chandler to determine which pair know the other better.
friends.4-13: Kathy's sexy role in a play irks Chandler; personal-shopper Rachel develops a crush on a client.
friends.4-14: Joey doesn't smell too good when he's about to appear in a Charlton Heston movie; Rachel asks Ross to entertain her boss's niece so she can be with Joshua; the girls join heartbroken Chandler at a strip joint.
friends.4-15: Ross plays rugby to impress Emily; to escape Janice, Chandler claims he's being transferred; Monica obsesses over a useless switch.
friends.4-16: Rachel throws an impromptu going-away party for Emily to lure Joshua into a social setting; pregnant vegetarian Phoebe craves meat.
friends.4-17: Ross pursues his romance with Emily; Phoebe learns she's having triplets; the boys get free adult TV.
friends.4-18: Rachel gears up for a night of romance with Joshua; Ross fears Emily is getting too chummy with Susan; Phoebe names one of the triplets.
friends.4-19: Ross proposes to Emily; Rachel and Monica demand their apartment back from the guys.
friends.4-20: Monica tries on Emily's wedding dress; Ross's plans affect Rachel and Joshua; Chandler insists Joey get help for his snoring.
friends.4-21: In a clip show, Rachel receives her invitation to Ross and Emily's wedding.
friends.4-22: Best man Joey loses Ross's heirloom ring; pregnant Phoebe has mood swings.
friends.4-23: London's the location for Ross and Emily's wedding, but back at home, Rachel realizes that she still loves the groom-to-be.
friends.4-24: As Ross and Emily prepare to wed, Rachel makes a frantic attempt to reach London before the ceremony. Elsewhere, there is no love lost between Ross's and Emily's fathers.
friends.5-1: Ross and Rachel cope with the ramifications of Ross saying "Rachel" instead of "Emily" during his wedding vows; Monica and Chandler are still hot for each other.
friends.5-2: Rachel wants to tell Ross that she still loves him; Chandler must kiss Rachel and Phoebe to cover up a kiss with Monica; Phoebe's water breaks.
friends.5-3: Phoebe's pregnancy comes to fruition; Monica and Chandler have their first fight.
friends.5-4: Phoebe reveals her hatred of PBS; Emily tells Ross she'll see him again---if he stops seeing Rachel.
friends.5-5: Monica and Chandler plan a weekend getaway; Ross has to tell Rachel that to save his marriage he can't see her anymore.
friends.5-6: Emily's demands regarding Rachel weigh on Ross; Rachel and Monica encounter a hairy, beastlike man; Phoebe receives a fur coat.
friends.5-7: Ross moves in with the boys; Phoebe dates a health inspector; Rachel plays hard to get for Danny, who's oblivious.
friends.5-8: The gang reflects on bad Thanksgivings---and the biggest turkey belongs to Monica, who recalls her first encounter with Chandler.
friends.5-9: Ross loses it when someone eats his sandwich at work; keeping up appearances for Monica and Chandler makes Joey look bad; Phoebe and Rachel take a lit class.
friends.5-10: Danny's close relationship with his sister (Julie Lauren) bothers Rachel; Ross urges Joey to write a script; Phoebe collects for holiday charity on a street corner.
friends.5-11: Rachel's New Year's resolution not to gossip is tested when she discovers Monica and Chandler's romance.
friends.5-12: Monica meets "Work Chandler"; Ross gets together with Janice.
friends.5-13: Phoebe meets Frank Sr. (Bob Balaban) at her grandma's funeral; Joey gets attached to a bag that's like a purse.
friends.5-14: Phoebe finds out about Monica and Chandler's romance; Ross plans to rent Ugly Naked Guy's apartment.
friends.5-15: Chandler freaks out over the subject of marriage to Monica; Joey's girlfriend throws playful, but painful, punches; Ross alienates his new neighbors.
friends.5-16: Phoebe finds a police badge; Joey has a romantic dream about Monica; Rachel helps Ross move his new couch.
friends.5-17: Rachel makes an awkward move during a job interview; Monica and Chandler compete with Phoebe and Gary to be the hotter couple.
friends.5-18: Rachel takes up smoking for work reasons; Joey angles into an audition involving Ross's son, Ben.
friends.5-19: Ross's flirting with the pizza-delivery girl falls flat; Joey's scene in a TV crime drama is cut.
friends.5-20: The boys ride along with Gary (Michael Rapaport); Monica and Rachel overhear bride-to-be Emily's urgent phone message to Ross.
friends.5-21: Gary (Michael Rapaport) asks Phoebe to live with him; a game of catch goes on for hours; Rachel buys an expensive cat.
friends.5-22: Joey is cast in an independent film to be shot in the desert outside Las Vegas; Phoebe's angry with Ross.
friends.5-23: Chandler and Monica celebrate their first anniversary; the gang goes to Vegas to visit Joey; Chandler finds out about Monica's lunch with Richard.
friends.5-24: In Vegas, Monica and Chandler reconcile and literally roll the dice on whether to get married, while one couple actually do tie the knot.
friends.6-1: Ross and Rachel experience the world's worst hangover when they realize they've gotten married. Chandler and Monica back away from their own altar plans. Phoebe and Joey head back to New York in the taxi cab.
friends.6-2: Monica and Chandler decide to move in together, leading Rachel to believe that all three of them will be roommates, and Monica doesn't want to tell her the truth. Meanwhile, Ross tries to keep Rachel from learning that their marriage hasn't been annulled.
friends.6-3: Monica and Chandler disagree over how to redecorate Rachel's old room. Joey advertises for a "non ugly" roommate. Ross is unwilling to accept that he is still in love with Rachel.
friends.6-4: Rachel prepares to move in with Ross. Ross is asked to give a lecture at NYU. Phoebe's psychic tells her that she will die before the end of the week. Joey discovers his SAG health insurance has lapsed due to his lack of work.
friends.6-5: The gang is mad at Ross. Joey tries to find the owner of a Porsche who left their keys in Central Perk. Monica and Chandler agree to baby-sit Frank and Alice's triplets for Phoebe. Rachel decides to move in with Phoebe.
friends.6-6: Chandler and Monica are moving in with each other, which means Rachel is moving in with Phoebe, and Joey will be without a roommate. Meanwhile, Ross doesn't want to help with the packing so he stays at home with Ben, or so they think. Joey doesn't know how to live by himself, so Chandler decides to "lose" money to him in various games.
friends.6-7: Rachel and Phoebe decide to start running together, but Rachel is thrown off by the fact that Phoebe runs like a four-year-old. Joey finds a sexy new female roommate. Chandler decides to surprise Monica by cleaning the apartment, but forgets where everything goes. Ross tries to help him fix the apartment before Monica gets home.
